title: Direct Response Copywriter
description:
Overview

Pure is looking for a Direct Response Copywriter to join our team! As our creative head, you will be responsible for the ideation, scripting, planning, and managing of the entire creative process with a big focus on UGC ads and psychology-based creatives to be used across paid marketing channels.

We are looking to hire someone with 3+ years of work experience. The ideal candidate has prior experience in creating paid advertisements specifically for Meta Platforms, UGC, direct response marketing & bonus points if experience with influencer / UGC partnerships.

Who are we?

At Pure , we are dedicated to transforming lives by creating high-quality supplements backed by science and trusted by our growing community. Our mission is to make achieving better health simpler, more effective, and more accessible for everyone. Since our launch, we’ve scaled rapidly through viral digital marketing and built a passionate customer base that loves and trusts our products. We operate with a small but mighty team that thrives on innovation, data-driven growth, and relentless creativity—and we’re excited to bring on a Creative Strategist to play a pivotal role in scaling our brand even further.

What is our culture like & who is a good fit?

Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We utilize creativity to do more with less - and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by the following three core values : \"work smart\", \"overdeliver\", \"speed is king\" and \"better everyday\". We love learning - every problem is an opportunity to grow. If you want a stress-free corporate 9-5 job, this isn\'t it.

If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast-growing company, work directly with the founders- and play a huge role in scaling it to $12M+ a year. Drive results with a group of passionate, smart & hardworking fun people. Work in an environment without politics, or corporate chicanery. Play a big part in our growth being hands on, active, and doing what is necessary with an excellent bonus plan based on performance then you have come to the right place.

Key Objectives

  • Manage the full creative process (from scripting all the way to final creative) in order to produce high converting creatives on an ongoing basis.
  • Work with our content manager to find, manage and source new content to be used across all marketing channels
  • Drive measurable improvements in core advertising metrics across digital channels with improved creatives.
  • Script UGC Direct response creatives
  • Use data from creative performance on Meta to dissect, analyze and improve upon our creatives to continuously improve performance across our creatives.
  • Work with our marketing team to come up with new creative concepts and ideas.
  • Conduct strategic customer and competitor research to better optimize creative efforts
  • Provide creative reports on a monthly and quarterly basis
  • Decide on the next steps needed to scale Meta Ads further through better creative

Requirements

  • Fully remote
  • Fluent in English
  • Direct Response Expertise : 3+ Years Experience with performance creative for DTC brands or working at a creative agency is a must.
  • Tools & Metrics : Proficiency in performance analytics tools such as Triple Whale, Motion, pitch decks, and spreadsheets to present ideas and campaign outcomes effectively.
  • UGC Experience : Lots of experience with creating briefs for UGC creators to produce high converting content across paid channels.
  • Creative & Analytical Mindset : Ability to generate fresh ideas, write scripts, shot listing, and make data-driven decisions based on ad performance.
  • No issue working overtime or on the weekends if needed. You wouldn’t know what to do with your free time if you were working less. You are passionate about your work.
  • Excellent cultural fit as per our values above.
  • Are excited to play a big role in scaling the company and work closely with the founders.
  • Basic psychology-based copywriting skills

Accountabilities

  • Brainstorm and pitch weekly ad ideas aligned with direct response principles.
  • Write 80-100 high-converting ad scripts per week for Meta Platforms
  • Come up with static ad ideas on a weekly basis
  • Analyze performance metrics to derive actionable insights for future campaigns.
  • Collaborate with editors and designers to ensure ads are visually compelling and on-brand.
  • Adapt ad strategies to capitalize on emerging internet trends and consumer behaviors.
  • Present performance analyses and creative strategies to the marketing team
  • Continuously refine ad concepts and troubleshoot underperforming campaigns to achieve maximum ROI.
  • Iterate on winning ads to create more winning assets to produce a better ROI.

How Our Hiring Works & How We Operate

When hiring, we’ll work with you to define the KPIs you’ll be responsible for and set targets. This removes ambiguity around wondering if you’re doing a good job after you start.

Initial soft interview, then a technical interview + test project with the current head of marketing, and a final interview to ensure culture fit. We plan to hire within ~8 - 10 days of conducting these interviews. We pride ourselves on timely responses and updates for applicants.

For this specific role, we will walk you through the long-term vision and opportunities that have us excited about this business - and how you fit in. We will show you our current structure and where we are headed!

Salary Expectation

USD $36,000 USD to $70,000 USD per year + Performance Bonus Structure based on experience and expertise.

title: Junior Linux Kernel Engineer - Ubuntu
description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Junior Linux Kernel Engineer - Ubuntu role at Canonical .

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

Every year we select new junior professionals into the Canonical Kernel Team, to work on the Linux kernel for Ubuntu. If you've enjoyed operating systems in your coursework or current role, you are confident in your ability to write high quality C and possibly Rust, and are ready to take the plunge and see how it all works, then this would be a great place to pursue your next career stage. We are a global team working to ship the world's most widely used Linux kernel, across the very latest silicon and cloud, where you can apply and grow your software engineering skills.

The Canonical Kernel Team builds and maintains all supported Ubuntu Linux kernels for a variety of platforms and architectures from small embedded devices to standard desktop/server systems to large-scale cloud environments. In your first year you will tackle serious initiatives, which include but are not limited to:

  • Optimized solutions for key Silicon and Cloud partner platforms
  • Developer platforms such as Raspberry Pi and RISC-V
  • Enabling Ubuntu on a wide range of embedded systems
  • Security hardening and exploit mitigation
  • Third-party driver integration and distribution, such as graphics
  • Expanded driver support for bleeding-edge PC platforms

We select candidates that are recent university graduates or early career professionals who are enthusiastic to develop kernel-level software in multiple areas including security updates, patching, and testing. The successful candidate will have a background in software engineering, be motivated to work in a distributed team and willing and able to travel globally twice a year for company engineering events.

These are full-time positions available to prospective or recently graduated students.

Location: We have home-based Kernel Teams in every timezone.

The role entails

  • Collaborate regularly and proactively with a globally distributed team
  • Learn from senior mentors to demystify the inner workings of the Linux kernel and how it is distributed
  • Work closely with external silicon, cloud, or hardware manufacturer delivery teams on bleeding-edge platforms
  • Diagnose and resolve issues in the kernel reported by customers, the community, and discovered by your own rigorous testing
  • Take personal responsibility for the delivery of various flavors of the Ubuntu Linux kernel
  • Improve tooling and automation for delivery and test of Ubuntu Linux kernels
  • Submit, review, and apply kernel patches, working with both internal and external upstream maintainers

What we are looking for in you

  • Well-organized and motivated self-starter able to thrive in a remote work environment
  • Professional manner with colleagues, business partners, and the open-source community
  • Ability to communicate effectively in English, both written and verbal
  • Programming experience in C and/or Rust
  • Familiarity with version control practices, ideally with git
  • Understanding of operating system kernel fundamentals
  • Ability to travel twice a year for company events of up to two weeks length

Nice-to-have skills

  • Interest and experience in Rust
  • Python and Bash scripting ability
  • Prior experience with Ubuntu/Debian/Snap packaging
  • Demonstrated experience with kernel patching and debugging
  • Strong grasp of device drivers, BSP's, and other low level system engineering

description:
Join to apply for the Client Operations Manager role at Chore

As the Operations Program Manager / Chief of Staff (Client Accounts), you’ll run back-office ops (HR, Finance, Compliance) for multiple startups—owning delivery, triaging edge cases, and building scalable processes.

About Us

Chore exists to make every startup and SMB in the world successful. We believe that the more successful startups, the better a world we’ll all experience.

Operations are foundational yet most companies chronically underinvest in them to their detriment. We build and maintain their back-office operations so that they can focus on their differentiating superpowers.

We work behind the scenes to help our clients win. We like efficiency. We geek out on checklists. We are transparent with each other and our clients. We are professional, inclusive, and autonomous and our goal is to provide a culture that fosters long-term success, is reputation & trust-based, fun, and pushes each of us to always learn.

We are looking for proactive, detail-oriented individuals interested in joining as a "Chore CEO" (what we call our operation program managers). Lead multi-workstream back-office programs (HR/Finance/Compliance) for startups; unblock teams and leaders, and deliver outcomes across a client portfolio.

You are the main conduit through which all our client's back-office operations run. You are their project manager and leader. You are the person they trust to keep things running so they can focus on their product and sales.

A Chore CEO serves as a fractional Chief of Staff/Chief Operating Officer — working with multiple startup founders / CEOs to project manage key corporate matters. These responsibilities are often tactical, but as you build trusted relationships with the CEOs of these world-changing startups, you will also become their strategic partner. In short, you are the unsung hero and critical foundation to their startup. Successful project manager operations leads get it done, figure it out, proactively get ahead of problems, and communicate every step.

Some examples of the work we do

  • The operations team is sometimes the dumping ground for things that don't go anywhere else. While others are bothered by that, we revel in it. We get it done when no one else can.
  • Use judgment and thoughtfulness — “can you work with our accountant to get taxes filed?” or “can you get this NDA out to a customer and coordinate if there are any issues?”
  • Research and problem-solving for back-office edge cases.
  • Be smart enough and skilled enough to jump from a finance question to an HR question to a vendor question.
  • We handle the complex unknowns.
  • Strategic work — e.g., “how should I think about compensation and benchmarks for my company?” We’ve seen this organically happen at times when OPs have built a trusted relationship with clients.

Qualifications/Skills

  • 5+ years of startup business experience that includes interfacing with clients or external parties is required.
  • 2+ years experience in at least two of the following: Project management, Product management, Customer Success, Client Operations, HR, Finance, Legal/Law/Attorney, or Compliance.
  • Proactive, detail-oriented, and excellent ability to context switch.
  • Great communication skills: this includes not only an ability to talk on a call but much more so, write down every step and communicate the value of that step, effectively.
  • Ability to say "no" in a way that doesn’t feel like a "no" to the other party.
  • You love building deep, trusting relationships with dynamic founders across many industries.
  • Are a total geek for better processes, more standardization, and reinventing things just enough to make them more efficient. You enjoy improving every day. You know what Kaizen means and the fact we care about it excites you.
  • Checking items off of your work list, while also considering ‘how can I do this process more efficiently,’ brings a smile to your face. There is always more to do for clients and you thrive on getting things done while simultaneously knowing that you are helping to move these amazing startups forward.
  • People who have a deep dedication to client service and doing right by our stakeholders.
  • Seeing delight on a client's face brings delight to your day.
  • Ability to focus in stressful situations and almost automatically prioritize.
  • Openness to giving and receiving feedback.
  • You don't mind doing the unsexy part of running a startup - i.e. dealing with regulators (including waiting on hold forever for them to pick up), managing employee offboarding, and basically doing the "startup plumber" work.
  • If you believe you deserve to only work on "sexy things" then this isn’t the role for you. We live in the unsexy but critical.
  • You want to join a passionate, fun and kind team for the long-term (2+ years). While this role might be a stepping stone and we celebrate our team member’s growth, if you apply, our assumption is that you’d prefer a job where you can see yourself for several years.

Compensation

  • Base compensation, starting compensation is $40,000 USD per year but we expect most teammates, once ramped and with bonus, will earn around $52,000 USD or more per year.
  • Every team member receives equity in Chore, which is variable based on level. Since we're building for the long-term, we offer equity on the high side.
  • Note: we do not negotiate as we believe it is biased against various groups and creates poor dynamics. Instead, we pay and promote based on performance and meeting clearly defined metrics.

The Best Parts

  • ️ We are fully remote, do not require any travel and have somewhat flexible hours! The expectation is that all Chore CEOs work standard US hours from 9-5pm.
  • We’re good people who work well together while solving critical problems for awesome startups.

  • Why is "executive" coaching only valuable for executives? We think that's stupid. Optional coaching 2x/mo.

  • Support from a team of other experts and teamwork to complete your work.

Additional Notes

  • There will be five 15-60 minute interviews via Google Meet, one of which is a Q&A with another Chore CEO to vet the role for you, too!
  • To help set you up for the success, half of the questions are provided for the 1st interview
  • We will ask for up to 4 former (or current) manager references.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. We are hiring a Project Manager - Ubuntu Embedded Systems at Canonical
As a Project Manager for Canonical's Devices business, this role is responsible for the coordination and completion of large complex customer-facing projects, overseeing all aspects of project delivery and acting as the primary delivery liaison between Canonical's engineering teams and Canonical's customers.
You will be managing the projects that involve the delivery of Ubuntu images on a wide variety of devices ranging from robots, edge gateways, and IoT devices to PCs and automotive systems. This is a high-profile project management position where you are expected to build and maintain working relationships with team members, customers, other partners/vendors (Silicon vendors, OEMs, ODMs, IHVs), and other Canonical departments/teams.
Location: This role will be based remotely in the AMERICAs and/or EMEA regions.

  • Managing projects through their complete life cycle and ensuring that the overall goals for both Canonical and the client are met
  • Successfully delivering engineering professional services for assigned projects
  • Working with engineering teams on custom board enablement and delivery of Ubuntu images to the customers
  • Assisting in the development of project statements of work
  • Drafting and maintaining project-specific schedules/project plans
  • Obtaining client agreement to the project schedule and agreed-upon work items
  • Ensuring projects are delivered within the time/resources/scope expectations
  • Managing project risk mitigation and plans
  • Driving technical issues to reach desired delivery outcomes
  • Maintain daily and weekly communication with the client and all internal stakeholders
  • Managing delivery schedule of critical third-party deliverables for the project
  • Keeping management informed of the status of assigned projects
  • Identifying custom engineering requests that are not part of an existing business contract
  • Advocating the appropriate technologies from Canonical's product portfolio to customers
  • Supporting different time zones and work non-traditional hours as required to support the assigned projects
What we are looking for in you
  • Solid project management experience in delivering engineering services to customers managing software development teams and field engineers
  • Extensive experience successfully managing projects with cross-cultural and multi-continent internal and external project resources, preferably with resources in Asia, Europe, and the Americas
  • Educational degree preferably in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Math
  • Good knowledge of Linux and the wider Open Source Software community, and understanding of computer architecture
  • Excellent communications skills, both verbal and written, in English
  • Strong leader and problem solver with extensive experience building successful internal and external partnerships and effective working relationships with demanding project sponsors in complex organizational environments
  • PMP/PMI or PRINCE2 Practitioner Certification preferred
  • Ability to work non-standard work hours in support of a worldwide sales and project team
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. description:
Overview

Estou buscando por um(a) Gestor(a) de Projetos com perfil ágil, organizado e versátil para me apoiar na gestão e operação de três negócios distintos: design, bebidas experimentais e imóveis.

A função envolve atuar no dia a dia desses projetos organizando tarefas, acompanhando entregas, negociando com fornecedores e ajudando a manter tudo em andamento. É essencial ter boa comunicação escrita, inclusive em inglês (leitura e escrita), familiaridade com ferramentas de gestão de projetos como Notion ou ClickUp, e disposição para lidar com frentes variadas; desde o acompanhamento de entregas de design para clientes internacionais até o suporte para a organização de um projeto de reforma de um imóvel, operação de uma microindústria de bebidas ou manutenção de uma campanha de anúncios.

A função envolverá também atuação direta para garantir que as coisas aconteçam de ponta a ponta : orçar, comprar, agendar, organizar cronogramas, negociar com fornecedores, atualizar planilhas, resolver pendências e destravar o que for preciso.

É fundamental que a pessoa tenha facilidade real para aprender coisas novas e complexas, com raciocínio rápido e capacidade de entender contextos variados com profundidade. Muitos dos projetos envolvem temas técnicos diversos e pouco padronizados, que exigem agilidade para pesquisar, interpretar e aplicar informações com autonomia. Busco alguém com inteligência prática, curiosidade ativa e flexibilidade para navegar entre assuntos distintos, aprendendo rapidamente o uso de ferramentas e processos de acordo com novos desafios.

Funções em cada frente de atuação

Design (Bas-Alto)

Estúdio de design com atuação internacional (apenas clientes estrangeiros, em inglês) em projetos de identidade visual, website e product design.

  • Comunicação escrita com clientes e parceiros (em inglês) para acompanhamento de projetos.
  • Delegação, briefing e hand-off de tarefas para o time de designers;
  • Acompanhamento de entregas em projetos simultâneos.

Bebidas (Caêm do Brasil)

Microindústria de sidras e bebidas fermentadas com sede em Curitiba.

caembrasil.com.br | instagram.com / caembrasil

  • Gerenciamento de campanhas de marketing, tráfego pago e vendas;
  • Apoio em lançamentos e planejamento de novos produtos;
  • Participação em reuniões semanais com a equipe para priorização e delegação de tarefas;
  • Apoio administrativo, financeiro e operacional do negócio.

Negócios Imobiliários

Micro incorporadora focada em house flipping e construção de casas modernistas em Belo Horizonte.

  • Apoio geral na organização e logística de reformas e obras;
  • Acompanhamento dos projetos com as equipes responsáveis;
  • Organização de planilhas e sistemas como Notion e Google Sheets.

Requisitos e perfil profissional

  • Proatividade real e pique de fazer acontecer;
  • Agilidade para mover entre contextos variados e mergulhar em novos desafios;
  • Organização e experiência com gerenciamento de projetos;
  • Facilidade em aprender novas ferramentas ou se aprofundar em tópicos variados;
  • Clareza na escrita e na comunicação;
  • Inglês fluente (leitura e escrita);

Diferenciais

  • Interesse ou experiência no mundo do design, marketing, produtos digitais, arquitetura ou bebidas;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas como Notion, planilhas e sistemas de produtividade;
  • Entendimento de processos de design e experiência com ferramentas da área, como o Figma.

Formato

  • Carga horária integral, com horários flexíveis;
  • Trabalho 100% remoto, com preferência para quem reside em Curitiba ou Belo Horizonte - mas não necessário;
  • Remuneração: entre R$3.000 a R$5.000+, conforme o nível de senioridade e autonomia prática;

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa com perfil comercial, excelente capacidade de comunicação e apresentação, que tenha facilidade para redesenhar processos operacionais dos clientes, identificar gaps e implementar melhorias usando as soluções digitais da Hilti, especialmente o ON!Track (solução digital que ajuda empresas a gerenciar ferramentas, equipamentos e ativos em tempo real). Este papel é essencial para garantir uma experiência de cliente excepcional e sustentável, atuando em parceria com os times de vendas e marketing locais e regionais.

Em que se consiste o trabalho?

Você será responsável por liderar a implementação dos nossos serviços digitais, com foco em:
  • Treinamento de clientes e melhoria de processos operacionais.
  • Compreensão profunda dos fluxos de trabalho dos clientes para aumentar a produtividade com as soluções Hilti.
  • Coordenação com os times de vendas e marketing locais e regionais para garantir colaboração e inovação.
  • Apoio ao lançamento e adoção de novas funcionalidades dos serviços.
  • Atuação prática e estratégica junto aos clientes, com visitas frequentes e engajamento direto.
  • Este papel exige mobilidade frequente em todo o Brasil,de 2 a 3 semanas por mês (de segunda a sexta-feira).

Isto é o que você precisará:

  • Formação superior completa (não é necessário curso específico).
  • Experiência comercial com foco em relacionamento com clientes.
  • Habilidades de comunicação, apresentação e engajamento.
  • Capacidade de estruturar processos e pensar de forma operacional.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens frequentes.
  • Inglês intermediário (desejável).

Por que vale a pena enviar sua candidatura?

Nossos funcionários compartilham um estilo muito próprio de ser. São determinados e dedicados, dando sempre o melhor si para exceder as expectativas dos nossos clientes. Em contrapartida, usufruem de carreiras incrivelmente dinâmicas e diversificadas. 93% dos nossos colaboradores dizem estar orgulhosos em trabalhar para a Hilti, graças à qualidade dos nossos produtos e a forma como cuidamos dos nossos colaboradores.

  • Vale alimentação/refeição
  • PPR – Plano de Participação nos Resultados
  • Totalpass (convênio com academias)
  • Seguro de Vida
  • EAP - Programa de Orientação Pessoal (Psicológica, Jurídica, Financeira e Social)
  • Niverday – 1 dia de folga no mês do seu aniversário
  • Auxílio Educacional
  • Premiação por tempo de serviço
  • Cultura de cuidado: gifts em datas especiais

  • Modelo de trabalho flexível

title: Email Marketing Manager Brazil Remote (any location) MARKETING
description:
Location: Remote
Need: Experience with Klaviyo

Description:

We’re looking for a sharp, creative, and data-driven Email Marketing Strategist who knows Klaviyo inside out and can turn email and SMS channels into revenue machines. This is for a fast-growing marketing agency that partners with DTC brands to deliver real results—not vanity metrics.

If you love building campaigns and flows that actually convert, get a kick out of testing subject lines and segmentation, and can read performance data like it’s a novel, this role is for you. You’ll own email and SMS strategy for a portfolio of DTC brands, working closely with clients, creatives, and performance teams to make every send count.

What You’ll Do:

→ Own the Strategy: Develop and execute email & SMS marketing plans that drive retention, engagement, and sales.
→ Build Flows that Work: Design and optimize automated flows (welcome, abandon cart, post-purchase, etc.) that deliver measurable results.
→ Segment Like a Pro: Create audience segments based on behavior, demographics, and purchase history for hyper-targeted campaigns.
→ Analyze & Optimize: Track KPIs (open rate, CTR, conversions, deliverability) and make data-backed adjustments to improve performance.
→ Creative Collaboration: Work with designers and copywriters to ensure emails not only look amazing but convert.
→ Stay Ahead of Trends: Keep up with best practices in Klaviyo, email deliverability, and retention marketing.


What We’re Looking For:

→ Experience Required: 1–3 years in email marketing with proven Klaviyo experience (agency or DTC brand experience preferred).
→ Retention-Obsessed: You understand the lifecycle of a customer and how to keep them coming back.
→ Data-Driven Mindset: You can interpret metrics and turn them into actionable strategy.
→ Strong Communication Skills: You can explain your ideas clearly to both creative teams and clients.
→ Attention to Detail: From subject lines to send times, you sweat the small stuff.
→ Bonus Points: Experience with SMS marketing and A/B testing tools.


Why This Role Rocks:

title: UX/UI Engineer
description:
Overview

Ruby Labs is a leading tech company that creates and operates innovative consumer products across health, education, and entertainment. One of RubyLabs’ portfolio companies is looking for a mid-level UI/UX Engineer to join our team and take full ownership of designing and implementing user interfaces using pre-built component libraries. This role is perfect for a frontend engineer who enjoys working within structured design systems and ensuring high-quality, data-driven user experiences. You will be responsible for both defining the UI structure using existing components and implementing it in code—without relying on a separate designer. If you thrive in a results-driven environment, value autonomy, and enjoy building intuitive, scalable UI without subjective design guesswork, this is the role for you.

Responsibilities

  • UI/UX design and implementation: Design web interfaces using pre-built components (NextUI, HeroUI, Tailwind).
  • Ensure consistency, usability, and accessibility across designs.
  • Create wireframes and layouts based on structured design principles.
  • Frontend development: Implement designs using NextUI, HeroUI, and Tailwind CSS on top of Next.js and React.
  • Develop and maintain scalable, maintainable, and performant UI and reusable components.
  • Ensure cross-browser compatibility and responsiveness.
  • Collaboration and process: Work with product managers to translate data-driven requirements into UI solutions.
  • Ensure seamless handoff between design and development by owning both parts of the process.
  • Maintain high coding standards and efficient workflows.

Qualifications

  • 2+ years of frontend development experience (Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind).
  • Strong understanding of UI/UX principles and ability to work within structured design systems.
  • Experience with UI component libraries (NextUI, HeroUI, or similar).
  • Ability to design and structure UI without relying on a dedicated designer.
  • Proficiency in HTML and CSS, writing clean, maintainable code.
  • Familiarity with design tools (Figma, Visily) to work with assets.
  • Experience with version control systems (Git).
  • Portfolio showcasing at least 5 projects where you handled both UI design and frontend implementation.

Nice to have

  • Experience working with design systems and component-based architecture.
  • Background in D2C product development or performance marketing.
  • Experience optimizing accessibility and usability.

Location

Ruby Labs operates within the CET Central European Time zone. Applicants from any country are welcome to apply for the position as long as they are located within approximately plus or minus 4 hours of CET. This ensures optimal collaboration and communication during working hours.

Benefits

  • Remote Work Environment Embrace the freedom to work from anywhere anytime, promoting a healthy work life balance.
  • Unlimited PTO Enjoy unlimited paid time off to recharge and prioritize your well being, without counting days.
  • Paid National Holidays Celebrate and relax on national holidays with paid time off to unwind and recharge.
  • Company-provided MacBook Experience seamless productivity with top notch Apple MacBooks provided to all employees who need them.
  • Flexible Independent Contractor Agreement Unlock the benefits of flexibility, autonomy, and entrepreneurial opportunities. Benefit from tax advantages, networking opportunities, reduced employment obligations, and the freedom to work from anywhere. Read more about it here:

Interview Process

  • Recruiter Screening (40 minutes)
  • Technical Interview (60 minutes)
  • Final Interview (60 minutes)

Life at Ruby Labs

At Ruby Labs, we are more than a team; we are a community united in pushing the boundaries of technology and innovation. Our combined passion fuels our ambition for excellence, driving impact that resonates around the globe. We are an equal-opportunity employer and celebrate diversity, recognizing that a diversity of thought and backgrounds builds stronger teams. We approach diversity and inclusion seriously and thoughtfully. We do not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, religion, color, place of birth, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, military service status, or disability status.

title: Contracts Specialist
description:
About The Role

VentureWell is seeking a Contracts Specialist to join our dynamic team to support contracting processes across a variety of programs. Responsibilities include drafting, reviewing and administering various contract types (including Firm Fixed Price and Time & Materials) and modifications. VentureWell’s funding includes Federal contracting dollars, so Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) experience is highly preferred. You will work closely with internal Programs teams to meet contracting needs with attention to detail that supports program goals. A thorough understanding of contracting principles, strong analytical skills, and the ability to balance multiple tasks are required.

Responsibilities

Program Contracting Support (80-90% of time)

  • Develop, maintain, and catalog process documents and agreement templates for contracting paid for by Organizational, Foundational, Federal, and Routine funding, as assigned
  • Liaise between organizational and programmatic stakeholders for agreement and approval on scopes of work and terms and conditions
  • Field and process internal requests for contract support
  • Process, record, and store agreements and delivery orders for review and execution
  • Support pre-award/procurement activities (Requests for Proposals, Requests for Information, Requests for Qualifications)
  • Track, manage, and communicate with consultants and vendors for materials required to satisfy agreement compliance conditions
  • Onboard new consultants and vendors as approved and requested
  • Support other Contracting and Expense Team members with recording expenses and ad hoc requests
  • Facilitate and project manage programmatic stipends process and expense recording
  • Track and manage consultant and contractor commitments
  • Create and deliver routine and ad hoc reporting to internal stakeholders as assigned or requested
  • Research and problem solve using precedent and policies for contracting concerns and emergent programs

General & Administrative (10-20% of time)

  • Development of process or procedure documentation to enhance or improve contracting operations
  • Training and participation in group meetings and department projects or objectives

What You Bring

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Finance, or Accounting preferred; Experience considered in lieu of degree
  • A minimum of 3 years of work experience, with at least one year working with contracts or experience working directly with VentureWell programs
  • Current or prior experience working in a full-time contracting capacity required
  • High degree of digital fluency using cloud-based office tools (G Suite, CRMs, team collaboration tools, and other web-based applications); ability to incorporate these tools into day-to-day work; specific experience with financial/accounting software (NetSuite or similar fund accounting software preferred)
  • Ability to succeed in an environment with competing and changing priorities and tight deadlines
  • Track record of building solid, collaborative working relationships; strong team player who is highly responsive and customer-service oriented
  • Self-starter with strong attention to detail and a commitment to delivering high-quality work
  • Highly adaptable and comfortable working with a degree of ambiguity
  • Outstanding written and oral communication skills with the ability to articulate and synthesize information in a compelling and organized manner

Across the Board, VentureWell Staff

  • Are able to succeed and thrive in an environment with competing and changing priorities and tight deadlines
  • Have track records of building solid collaborative working relationships and are proven team players with a customer-service orientation
  • Are committed to embedding equity for all in our internal practices and culture and in our programs to support the mission
  • Bring openness and engagement to personal, professional, and organization-wide learning
  • Are curious and committed to issues of environmental sustainability
  • Are self-starters with excellent attention to detail and a commitment to delivering high-quality work
  • Are active learners who independently learn new tools and work processes quickly
  • Have excellent written and oral communication skills

Our Benefits*

  • An attractive and equitable compensation package, including:
  • a salary range of $70-$80k commensurate with experience and internal equity
  • 403(b) with 200% match up to a maximum contribution from VentureWell of 10% when the employee puts in 5% (eligible after one year of service for the match)
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance
  • $1,000 home office stipend upon hire
  • A true focus on work-life balance with work weeks that reflect that
  • It’s our aim for our employees in this position to not work more than a 35-hour workweek
  • 20 paid vacation days
  • 12 paid holidays
  • 12 paid wellness days

*Benefits are reviewed each fiscal year and may be subject to change.

What We Offer

  • A culture where people work intentionally and collaboratively in pursuit of our mission
  • Values we believe in

About VentureWell

VentureWell supports the cultivation of science and technology inventors and the innovation and entrepreneurship ecosystems critical to their success. Since its founding in 1995, VentureWell has funded or trained over 19,000 early-stage science and technology inventors and innovators, resulting in the emergence of more than 5,800 ventures with groundbreaking technological advancements in fields like biomedicine and healthcare, sustainable energy and materials, and solutions for low-resource settings. We are hiring a Software Support Engineer to…

This role is an opportunity for a technologist with a passion for Linux and open source to build a career with Canonical and drive success for our customers, community and the company. If you have an affinity for open source software, great communication skills, and a passion for troubleshooting and fixing issues in technology used by millions across the world, then you will enjoy working with some of the best people in the industry at Canonical.
This role deals with critical issues in the open source stack that require upstream bug fixes. Our engineers are able to work productively at any level of the stack including the kernel and in a wide range of languages, to understand and address the software issues at hand. Our group is critical to the success of our customers, partners and Ubuntu itself.
You will help with troubleshooting and driving issues to resolution with workarounds, guidance, and bug fixes to be released upstream and in Ubuntu.
Location: This is a remote role, we have teams in all time zones.
The role entails

  • Resolve complex customer problems related to Ubuntu, Kernel, Ceph, OpenStack, or Kubernetes and other open source software
  • Maintain a close working relationship with Canonical's Field, Support and product engineering teams

  • Review code produced by other engineers
  • Demonstrate good judgment in technical methods and techniques
  • Prioritize work and manage your time effectively against those priorities
  • Participate in team discussions to improve processes, tools, and documentation
  • Maintain clear, technical and concise communications
  • Work from home and travel internationally up to 10% of work time for team meetings, events and conferences
What we are looking for in you
  • An exceptional academic track record
  • Background in Computer Science, STEM or similar
  • Experience with Linux and open source software
  • Experience with at least one of Python, Go, C or C++ on Linux
  • A drive to learn unfamiliar technology and deep-dive difficult issues

WHO WE ARE

At Trustly, we’re on a mission to deliver a better way to pay and get paid. Consumers deserve a payment option that prioritizes financial responsibility, and merchants should have the independence to accept payments without unnecessary costs. This mission drives everything we do.

We’re revolutionizing the payments industry by making Pay by Bank the new standard at checkout, providing a smarter payment option to credit and debit cards. For merchants and consumers, this means the freedom to make and receive payments with greater security and ease.

Fueled by this purpose, we’ve grown into a global network connecting 9,000 merchants to 650 million consumers through 12,000 banks across 33 countries, processing over $58 billion annually. As the leader in Pay by Bank, we aim to redefine the payments experience by delivering exceptional products and unmatched value.

With regional offices in Vitória, Brazil and Silicon Valley, USA, and our global headquarters in Stockholm, Sweden, we are a diverse team that spans over 30 nationalities. Embracing a culture of innovation and collaboration, our 'work from anywhere' policy allows employees in Brazil, the U.S., and Canada to work remotely within their country of residence, enabling flexibility while staying connected to our global team.

At Trustly, we believe that inclusion and diversity are essential foundations for building a fair and equitable society. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, ancestry, color, national origin, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, or disability status. Our main goal is to provide a fair, welcoming, diverse environment with opportunities for all collaborators. The stages of our selection process take place online and without distinction of any kind.

Now is the perfect time to join us and help accomplish our mission. If you’re inspired by purpose, thrive in a fast-paced and entrepreneurial environment, and are ready to shape the future of payments, we’d love to hear from you!

About the team

The Underwriting team is responsible for reviewing all new and existing insourced deals holistically by analyzing the merchants' compliance framework and risk controls, financial conditions, historical performance, and regulatory and legal environment.


What you will do:
  • Evaluate merchant applications and supporting documentation to assess Merchant’s credit and reputational risk.
  • Review financial statements and/or business tax returns and performs analysis to recommend merchant’s risk ratings.
  • Analyze complex corporate structures, beneficial ownership and licensing requirements, coordinating with the Compliance and Legal teams as needed.
  • Review industry information and comparisons, key risks and mitigants to form a general risk overview of merchants.
  • Summarize analysis in concise credit memo and complete all required underwriting checklists.
  • Underwrite according to applicable regulations, procedures, and guidelines.
  • Conduct periodic reviews for existing merchants to facilitate ongoing risk monitoring and management.
  • Maintain productivity standard goals as established by management.
  • Assist the Commercial team with customer calls for larger merchants requiring explanation of specific credit risks, internal credit policies and/or underwriting decisions.
  • Other duties as assigned.
Who you are:
  • High level of English proficiency both in oral and written communication.
  • Experience in a commercial underwriting role at a fintech, financial institution or payment service provider; experience underwriting complex multinational corporations is a plus.
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics or related discipline required.
  • Ability to analyze financial, bank, and processing statements to assess credit worthiness of merchants.
  • Review complex corporate structures, licenses, and beneficial ownership, coordinating with the compliance and legal teams as needed.
  • Familiarity with Know your Customer (KYC), Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and payment processing requirements in North America.
  • Ability to solve practical problems and interpret a variety of data furnished in oral, written, or schedule form.
  • Must be detail oriented, and able to manage and prioritize multiple tasks.
  • Prior payment and Fintech experience is a plus.

Why are you being asked to complete this form?

We are a federal contractor or subcontractor. The law requires us to provide equal employment opportunity to qualified people with disabilities. We have a goal of having at least 7% of our workers as people with disabilities. The law says we must measure our progress towards this goal. To do this, we must ask applicants and employees if they have a disability or have ever had one. People can become disabled, so we need to ask this question at least every five years.

Completing this form is voluntary, and we hope that you will choose to do so. Your answer is confidential. No one who makes hiring decisions will see it. If you want to learn more about the law or this form, visit the U.S. Department of Labor’s Office of Federal Contract Compliance Programs (OFCCP) website at .

How do you know if you have a disability?

A disability is a condition that substantially limits one or more of your “major life activities.” If you have or have ever had such a condition, you are a person with a disability. Disabilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Alcohol or other substance use disorder (not currently using drugs illegally)
  • Autoimmune disorder, for example, lupus, fibromyalgia, rheumatoid arthritis, HIV/AIDS
  • Blind or low vision
  • Cancer (past or present)
  • Cardiovascular or heart disease
  • Celiac disease
  • Cerebral palsy
  • Deaf or serious difficulty hearing
  • Diabetes
  • Disfigurement, for example, disfigurement caused by burns, wounds, accidents, or congenital disorders

  • Gastrointestinal disorders, for example, Crohn's Disease, irritable bowel syndrome

  • Mental health conditions, for example, depression, bipolar disorder, anxiety disorder, schizophrenia, PTSD

  • Neurodivergence, for example, attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD), autism spectrum disorder, dyslexia, dyspraxia, other learning disabilities

Overview

Join to apply for the Inbound Sales Representative role at Toptal .

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary

Our Inbound Sales Representatives connect and engage with prospective clients who originate from inbound leads. They seek new business opportunities by connecting with, and developing relationships with, potential customers and guiding prospective clients throughout the required sales stages. To excel in this position, you need to effectively communicate and collaborate with clients, ensuring they understand the value of our services and how Toptal can support their goals. Our ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, is hungry to exceed sales quotas, and strives to go above and beyond. If you are passionate about sales, innately driven, and results-oriented, this is the perfect opportunity for you to launch your sales career.

This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities

  • Sales Cycle Management: You will be the initial face of Toptal and support our clients through the required sales stages. As the first point of contact and the initial ‘face’ of Toptal for new clients, you will be responsible for moving these clients forward in the sales process, starting with regularly conducting sales calls. You will be responsible for accurately articulating the benefit of Toptal to potential clients in these calls and managing deal cycles from discovery through close.
  • Client Experience: You will execute a customer-centric approach across all client interactions during pre-defined working hours. You will build rapport with prospective clients, which will require researching clients before outreach and staying on top of industry trends and Toptal competitors.
  • Collaboration with Team Members: You will collaborate with your team to promptly respond to high-volume inbound client inquiries. Communicating via Zoom and Slack is critical to maintaining a high level of collaboration and clear communication within the team.
  • Growth and Development: Our SMB sales team members always look to improve individually and as a team. Being open to and implementing feedback will be critical to achieving success in this role at Toptal.

Qualifications and Job Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree is required.
  • The ideal candidate has 1-3 years of B2B sales experience (e.g., Account Executive, Inside Sales, Outside Sales Representative, Account Representative, or related title).
  • Software or tech-related sales experience and education are a plus.
  • Be attentive to client needs. You will be required to be fully available during your working hours to take client calls.
  • You are client-centric. You will be working with prospective clients daily, uncovering and resolving clients’ issues through value-based selling.
  • Have a “will-to-win” attitude. You’re looking to not only meet but exceed your quota and are naturally competitive. We provide a base salary plus uncapped commission and want our Client Advisors to make the most out of it!
  • You’re a “learn-it-all.” We are looking for someone who is always looking to grow, strives for improvement, and constantly seeks feedback from peers/leaders. Even as an individual contributor, you seek to share and gain knowledge from those around you.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with your team members.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work and thrive in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts. We move quickly, so having exceptional time management skills and the ability to manage a high volume of clients is key to being successful in this role.
  • You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

Canonical is building a comprehensive suite of multi-cloud and on-premise data solutions for the enterprise. We want to make it easy to operate any database on any cloud, or on premise. The data platform team covers the full range of data stores and data technologies, spanning from big data, NoSQL, cache-layer capabilities, and analytics; all the way to structured SQL engines like Postgres and MySQL. We aim to deliver fault-tolerant mission-critical distributed systems, and the world's best data platform.
We are looking for technical Engineering Managers to lead teams focused on Big Data and MySQL databases. We write code in Python and encode modern operational practices for data applications at scale on Kubernetes and cloud machines.
Location: This role can be filled in European, Middle East, African or any American region / time zone.

  • A software engineering background, preferably with Python and Golang experience

  • An open-minded attitude to new technologies and the drive to push the boundaries of what is possible
  • The ambition to build products that improve how people operate software and infrastructure everywhere

description:
Mixscience recrute un (une) Territory Manager Americas à Brazil pour un contrat permanent.

Acteur majeur de la nutrition animale en France et à l'international, Mixscience s'adresse aux fabricants d'aliments, aux intégrateurs et aux distributeurs pour contribuer au développement de filières d'élevage durables. Avec 500 collaborateurs, l'entreprise développe et commercialise une gamme de produits comprenant prémix, minéraux, spécialités innovantes et solutions de biocontrôle adaptées à différentes espèces.

Ce poste peut être basé en zone LATAM, pas obligatoirement au Brésil. Vous intégrerez l'équipe commerciale internationale et contribuerez au développement de notre présence en Amérique Latine et aux États-Unis. En tant que Territory Manager, vous définirez et mettrez en œuvre la stratégie commerciale, serez ambassadeur de Mixscience dans la zone, et gérerez la promotion des produits, les opérations commerciales, et la représentation de la marque.

Vos principales missions incluront :

  • Identifier les opportunités B2B, sélectionner les distributeurs, et élaborer un plan de développement des ventes localement adapté.
  • Assurer la prospection, le suivi clients, la promotion des solutions Mixscience, en veillant à leur conformité réglementaire.
  • Animer un réseau de partenaires, gérer commandes, facturation, litiges, appels d'offres, recouvrement, et fixer les conditions tarifaires en lien avec la direction.
  • Effectuer une veille concurrentielle et coordonner efficacement avec les équipes internes.
  • Reporter régulièrement l'activité à la direction.
  • Encadrer et accompagner les Account Managers de la zone, veiller à l'exécution de la stratégie commerciale, au développement des compétences, et à l'autonomie des collaborateurs.

Profil recherché :

  • Formation supérieure en commerce international, agronomie ou domaine connexe.
  • Expérience confirmée en développement commercial international, connaissance des marchés LATAM et USA, secteur de la nutrition animale ou agroalimentaire serait un atout.
  • Expérience en environnement B2B exigeant, capacité à structurer une approche marché, développer un portefeuille clients, et construire des partenariats durables.
  • Leadership avéré, expérience en management, autonomie, rigueur, analyse, prise de décision en environnement évolutif.
  • Maîtrise de l'anglais et de l'espagnol indispensable, aisance relationnelle, forte capacité d’adaptation multiculturelle.

Intéressé(e) ? Faites-nous parvenir votre CV et nous vous contacterons pour un premier échange. Si votre profil correspond, un entretien avec votre futur manager et RH suivra. Nous serons ravis de vous accueillir dans l'équipe !

Mixscience est une filiale d’Avril, leader dans la filière des huiles et protéines végétales, présent dans l’alimentation, la nutrition animale, les énergies renouvelables, avec un chiffre d'affaires de 8 milliards d'euros en 2023 dans 19 pays. Travailler chez Avril, c'est choisir une entreprise engagée pour la performance responsable, l'innovation, et la croissance durable. Plus d’informations sur avril.com .

description:
Job description

Na Atlas, temos pessoas apaixonadas, curiosas, questionadoras e ousadas, que buscam soluções de impacto para acelerar o nosso crescimento. Aqui, unimos tecnologia, infraestrutura, desenvolvimento, respeito e diversidade para construir relações significativas e duradouras.

Estamos em busca de pessoas que tenham brilho nos olhos diante de desafios e que desejem contribuir para a construção de um mundo melhor.

Temos um compromisso firme com a inclusão, a diversidade e o pertencimento. Não toleramos qualquer tipo de preconceito, porque acreditamos que inovação e transformação só florescem em ambientes de trabalho diversos e seguros.

Reforçamos que nossas vagas são especialmente destinadas a pessoas negras, indígenas, mulheres, LGBTQIA+, pessoas com deficiência (PCD) e todas as demais representações da diversidade. Junte-se a nós e seja parte dessa transformação!

Descrição da vaga:

Estamos buscando a primeira pessoa Product Marketer da Atlas Governance — alguém que ajudará a fundar e estruturar a disciplina de Product Marketing na empresa. Você terá a missão de criar os alicerces dessa função estratégica, conectando Produto, Marketing, Vendas e Customer Success.

É uma posição de construção do zero, com autonomia para criar, testar e escalar práticas. Reportando diretamente ao CRO, você será responsável por posicionamento, messaging, ICP e lançamento de produto – com foco em impacto na receita.


Main responsibilities

O que você vai fazer no seu dia a dia:

  • Construir a função e os processos de PMM do zero, com autonomia e liberdade de criação;
  • Atuar diretamente na definição da estratégia, em parceria com o time executivo, participando de decisões rápidas e da execução;
  • Desenvolver mensagens ousadas, fortes e persuasivas, que gerem conversão e engajamento;
  • Evoluir junto com a disciplina de PMM, com oportunidade clara de crescimento para posições de liderança.

Requirements and skills

O que estamos procurando na pessoa que vai fazer parte do time:

  • Experiência em Product Marketing, Product Management ou Marketing em empresas SaaS e B2B;
  • Experiência em atuar em diferentes frentes: conversas com clientes, alinhamento interno e execução de GTM;
  • Experiência em comunicar-se de forma clara, storytelling forte e presença executiva;
  • Histórico comprovado em conduzir iniciativas Cross-funcionais com resultados;
  • Capacidade de definir prioridades, resolver problemas e trabalhar com autonomia em ambientes de incerteza;
  • Experiência na resolução de problemas complexos usando dados (uso de produto, pipeline, adoção, entre outros);
  • Histórico e capacidade de influenciar decisões em diferentes níveis e áreas da organização;
  • Flexibilidade e adaptabilidade, com perfil colaborativo e gosto por ambientes acelerados;
  • Excelência em copywriting e visão prática de como Product Marketing impacta receita.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência em fundar e/ou estruturar Product Marketing em empresas em estágio inicial;
  • Possuir certificações em Winning by Design, Reforge, PMA, etc.

Additional information

A contratação é em modelo de Cooperativa e alguns dos nossos benefícios:

  • Ajuda de custo em Plano de saúde;
  • Ajuda de custo para home office;
  • Ajuda de custo para alimentação;
  • Aulas de Espanhol;
  • Folga no aniversário e no aniversário dos filhos.

description:
Overview

Somos o Grupo Casas Bahia, com mais de 70 anos de história, realizando os sonhos de +100 milhões de brasileiros.

Aqui, somos protagonistas o tempo todo, sempre com integridade e ética em tudo o que fazemos. A paixão pela nossa gente é o que nos move, e a dedicação total ao cliente é o nosso compromisso diário. Entregamos resultados e buscamos sempre a simplicidade em tudo o que fazemos!

Buscamos uma pessoa desenvolvedora para atuar remotamente no time de Cyber, com foco em testes de intrusão e segurança ofensiva, será responsável por avaliar e validar a segurança dos sistemas, redes e aplicações da empresa. Isso inclui a realização de testes de intrusão controlados, identificação e exploração de vulnerabilidades, bem como a elaboração de relatórios técnicos e executivos que apoiem na mitigação de riscos e no fortalecimento contínuo da postura de segurança da organização.

Main responsibilities

  • Realização, planejamento, execução, exploração, pós-exploração e elaboração de relatório técnico;
  • Desenvolver ou adaptar scripts/exploits para cenários específicos;
  • Apoiar tecnicamente a equipe de defesa com validação de técnicas de segurança ofensiva;
  • Realizar avaliações para dimensionamento de risco e identificar vulnerabilidades na infraestrutura de rede, propondo soluções para correção ou mitigação;
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com outras equipes de TI para explorar e propor soluções para os riscos levantados, envolvendo desde aplicações web, mobile, infraestrutura, redes e API's;
  • Fornecer treinamento e capacitação para a equipe interna sobre melhores práticas de segurança de rede e uso de ferramentas específicas;
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre ataques e vulnerabilidades recentes e tendências em segurança de rede, adaptando as estratégias de segurança conforme necessário.

Requirements and skills

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas relacionadas;
  • Experiência comprovada em análise de vulnerabilidades, incluindo a execução de testes de intrusão;
  • Experiência prática com ferramentas e técnicas ofensivas;
  • Conhecimentos em Sistemas Operacionais: Linux, Windows, Unix e macOS (permissões, processos, logging, automação);
  • Conhecimentos em Redes: TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S, SMB, RDP, SSH, VPNs, proxies e firewalls;
  • Conhecimentos em Pentests Web, Mobile e API: Frameworks OWASP (WSTG, MASTG, MASVS e MASTG), exploração de Aplicações Web, Interceptação de aplicações Mobile, Xposed, LSPosed, Frida e engenharia reversa para interceptação de API’s e lógica da aplicação.
  • Entendimento da exploração da infraestrutura, incluindo AD’s, conhecimento de ferramentas como: NXC, Crackmapexec, Bloodhound, Cobalt-Strike, Empire C2 Framework, Metasploit-Framework, Mimikatz e etc. Utilização de técnicas de exploração e persistência em SO’s Linux e Windows;
  • Conhecimentos em Python, Go, Powershell, Bash, C#, para criação de automações, ataques e scans.

Seria muito legal se você tivesse (diferenciais):

  • Certificações adicionais em segurança ofensiva, como DCPT, OSCP, eJPT, PNPT, CPTS;
  • Saber conduzir Pentests em ambientes AWS, GCP, Azure, conhecimento de roles e postura de segurança para exploração;
  • Exploração de ambientes de container/registry como: JFrog, Nexus, Harbor;
  • Entender e elaborar como falhas lógicas podem gerar cenários fraudulentos no ambiente varejista e bancário.

Additional information

Local de Trabalho: Brasil/Remoto

Confira alguns dos benefícios incríveis que preparamos para garantir seu bem-estar e qualidade de vida:

  • PLR/Bônus : Um reconhecimento extra para valorizar o seu esforço e dedicação!

Pessoa Engenheira de Dados - Sênior (Remoto)

Join to apply for the Pessoa Engenheira de Dados - Sênior (Remoto) role at Atlântico

Transformar a vida das pessoas através de inovação e tecnologia , este é o nosso propósito. Estamos procurando um(a) Pessoa Engenheira de Dados que queira impulsionar a inovação conosco!
Somos um Instituto de Pesquisa e Desenvolvimento formado por um time de pessoas incríveis, com ideias inovadoras, possuímos um ambiente descontraído e muito espírito colaborativo.
Promovemos em nosso dia-a-dia um ambiente de desenvolvimento , onde os Atlantes são o nosso maior foco, por isso um dos nossos valores mais fortes é a “Valorização de Pessoas” . Não é à toa, que estamos entre as melhores empresas de TI para se trabalhar no Brasil, segundo o ranking do GPTW.
Formação Acadêmica:

  • Bacharelado em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Ciência de Dados ou área relacionada.
  • Pós-graduação, Mestrado ou Doutorado é desejável.
Responsabilidades:
  • Colaborar com clientes para entender suas necessidades de dados e desenvolver soluções eficientes para extrair, transformar, armazenar e exibir dados.
  • Pesquisar sistemas internos para identificar dados disponíveis, sua estrutura, métodos de acesso e otimizar seu uso em sistemas e aplicações novos ou existentes.
  • Contribuir para o desenvolvimento de sistemas complementares que melhorem a disponibilidade de dados para a equipe do cliente.
  • Gerenciar múltiplas solicitações de alta prioridade simultaneamente, adaptando-se às mudanças de prioridades.
  • Identificar e interagir com as equipes do cliente para aprofundar o conhecimento das fontes de dados e tecnologias.
  • Liderar o desenvolvimento e aprimoramento de pipelines de dados, gerenciando novas solicitações de recursos e comunicando-se regularmente com os gerentes do clientes.
  • Desenvolver e manter plataformas para compartilhamento de dados e dashboards.
  • Criar documentação abrangente sobre fontes de dados, métodos de acesso, contatos-chave e outras informações relevantes.
  • Apresentar resultados obtidos para stakeholders em todos os níveis (técnicos e não técnicos) de forma clara e concisa.
Requisitos obrigatórios:
  • Experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento de software.
  • Experiência na construção e otimização de pipelines de processamento de dados em larga escala e à nível de produção, utilizando tecnologias distribuídas.
  • Experiência na configuração e utilização de plataformas de dados, especificamente soluções de dados baseadas em nuvem, incluindo a capacidade de provisionar e configurar recursos.
  • Experiência com Python (preferencialmente) ou outras linguagens para ciência de dados e análise.
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e SQL.
  • Experiência com bibliotecas populares de análise de dados (Pandas, NumPy, SciPy, Scikit-learn, etc.).
  • Experiência com bibliotecas populares de visualização de dados (Tableau Desktop/Server, matplotlib, seaborn, plotly, etc.).
  • Experiência na construção e otimização de pipelines de dados.
  • Experiência no design, construção e otimização de pipelines e plataformas de dados em larga escala utilizando:
  • Frameworks de processamento de dados distribuídos, por exemplo: Apache Spark, Apache Flink ou tecnologias similares baseadas em MapReduce
  • Sistemas de gerenciamento de recursos e armazenamento de Big Data, por exemplo: HDFS, YARN ou equivalentes em nuvem como S3, EMR
  • Ferramentas de orquestração de fluxo de trabalho, por exemplo: Apache Airflow, Dagster, Prefect
  • Formatos de tabela de data lake modernos, por exemplo: Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, Apache Hudi
  • Mecanismos de consulta SQL distribuídos para data lakes, por exemplo: Trino/Presto
  • Experiência na criação de soluções para adquirir e persistir novas fontes de dados para uso por cientistas de dados e analistas.
  • Experiência no uso de serviços baseados em nuvem, como AWS ou GCP, para transferência, processamento e armazenamento de dados.
Idioma:
  • Inglês avançado (leitura, escrita, conversação, técnico) para contato diário com parceiros no exterior.
Desejável:
  • Conhecimento de protocolos de rede, autenticação, criptografia e outras tecnologias que permitem uma comunicação de rede segura e eficiente.
  • Conhecimento de tecnologias de processamento em tempo real, como Kafka, Kinesis ou equivalentes.
  • Conhecimento de competências essenciais de gerenciamento de dados, incluindo governança, segurança e qualidade de dados.
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de integração de dados (Pentaho, OWB/ODI, SSIS, etc.).
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de exploração de dados (Jupyter Notebook, iPython, etc.).
  • Conhecimento de padrões de design comuns no desenvolvimento de software (MVC, MVVM, etc.).
  • Conhecimento de tecnologias como Hadoop, Hive, Cassandra e Kubernetes.
  • Conhecimento prático de sistemas de controle de versão de software (Git preferencialmente).
Vem ser Atlante!!!
DIVERSIDADE E INCLUSÃO:
No Atlântico, a diversidade e a inclusão são compromissos inegociáveis. Como instituto dedicado à pesquisa, desenvolvimento e inovação, valorizamos e incentivamos a pluralidade de pensamentos e vivências, pois isso faz parte do nosso DNA. Nossa missão é promover um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo e diverso, buscando a equidade de oportunidades e o respeito à diversidade cultural, religiosa, étnico-racial, de gênero, de orientação afetivo-sexual e de pessoas com deficiência, voltado para a defesa e valorização dos direitos humanos. Atualmente, o Atlântico possui uma subárea dedicada à diversidade e inclusão, inserida na área de Pessoas & Cultura. Essa subárea trabalha em colaboração com o Comitê de Diversidade e Inclusão e com os grupos de afinidades, que são compostos por pessoas voluntárias e têm como propósito oferecer um espaço seguro para a troca de vivências, a representatividade e a construção de ações afirmativas.
IMPACTO SOCIAL:
O Comitê de Diversidade e Inclusão do Atlântico investe em ações de voluntariado com foco no impacto social positivo por meio do Grupo de Afinidade de Justiça Social. Nós nos concentramos em apoiar organizações do terceiro setor e projetos de impacto social que trabalhem com os públicos que são contemplados pelos pilares do Atlântico. Em 2022, lançamos nosso primeiro projeto voltado para a capacitação de pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade social. O projeto-piloto foi realizado na Comunidade de Ancuri, em parceria com a organização Visão Mundial e a ONG Associação Santos Dias, e formou 40 jovens em Lógica de Programação Básica.

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

HR Professional | Passionate about Culture, Growth & People

Who We Are

ENG (engbim.com) is a BIM company that specializes in hands-on, field-focused BIM services. Founded in 2007, we have positioned ourselves as the largest and most experienced BIM production service provider in the United States, having completed 5,000 BIM projects with a dedicated team of over 600 staff members. We provide MEP Modeling, VDC/BIM Management, Laser Scanning, and Scan to BIM services, as well as a comprehensive array of BIM production services to architects, engineers, and owners.

The Role

The BIM Specialist role generally involves covering the modeling of different trades (MEP), depending on your background and expertise, whose extent will depend on the scope of the project (specific zones or entire buildings), and whose quality will go according to clients’ requirements and the services provided by the team you end up joining. This position requires a high level of modeling quality (expertise, technical knowledge, LOD and QAQC capabilities), and more autonomy in its self-management and modeling capabilities (studying whatever's necessary according to each trade). A BIM Specialist saves the client problems, detecting possible conflicts throughout the initial information review and the modeling and coordination phases.

Minimum mandatory requirements include:

  • An excellent level of English is an absolute must, both spoken and written . Aspiring candidates must be able to keep up with fluent conversations both with native and non-native speakers. Candidates without this requirement will NOT be considered .
  • Solid experience modeling HVAC and plumbing in Revit for commercial, industrial, healthcare, and residential construction . This can include things like process piping , ductwork and sheet metal , and mechanical equipment (pumps , AHUs , RTUs , chillers and boilers ), and for plumbing, domestic water , sanitary drainage and gray water , stormwater , medical gases , compressed air lines , pumps , heaters and hangers .
  • Experience coordinating or clash-detecting through Navisworks (Revizto can also be considered but Navisworks will be prioritized), knowledge of BIM coordination, clash report , QAQC and model accuracy .
  • A mechanical or civil engineering bachelors degree (architects could be considered but only if they have extensive experience modeling and coordinating MEP trades themselves).

Specific requirements will vary depending on the position and service. Experience with Level Of Detail (LOD) 400 and projects based in the US , or constructability knowledge related to that country will be a huge differential . Other desirable requirements are:

  • Familiarity with BIM add-ins (e.g., Evolve , SysQue , Fabrication Parts ).
  • Experience in conceptual design / BIM Design assist.
  • AutoCAD Plant 3D knowledge.
  • Dynamo/Python knowledge applied to BIM .
  • On-site/field experience .
  • Ability to produce detailed models, including real-world fittings and connection types .

Please know if you don't have experience working with Revit in formal jobs, it will be hard to consider your profile. Please DON'T apply if you don't have the necessary English level.

Tech & Office Allowances: Upgrade your workspace with our one-time allowances. With "Pimp up your Devices," and “Home Office set up allowance” you can upgrade gadgets for a better experience.

Monthly Internet Allowance: Stay connected with a monthly allowance for internet and expenses.

Highly Competitive Compensation Package: Includes both fixed and variable payments, all processed in our local currency, USD.

Join us and grow in a flexible, innovative environment!

Compensation will be in USD, competitive and commensurate with experience.

Clara is the fastest-growing company in Latin America. We've built the leading solution for companies to make and manage all their payments. We already help over 20,000 large and growing businesses operate with agility and financial clarity through locally issued corporate cards, bill pay, financing, and a powerful B2B platform built for scale.

We invite you to join us if you want to be part of a fast-paced environment that will accelerate your career and support you to do some of the best work of your life alongside a passionate and committed team distributed across the Americas.

We’re looking for anAccount Executive to help scale Clara’s footprint across Brazil by acquiring and expanding relationships with mid-sized to enterprise-level companies (100+ employees). You’ll join our Commercial team and focus on driving adoption of our SaaS platform and financial services—Conta and Cartão Clara.

This is a high-impact, high-volume sales role. You’ll be responsible for managing dozens of parallel negotiations while maintaining consistent prospecting activity to fuel pipeline growth. You’ll operate in a fast-paced, consultative environment where business acumen and execution matter.

You will:

Manage and grow a high-volume pipeline of qualified B2B opportunities using Hubspot CRM , maintaining strong execution across multiple concurrent deals

Prioritize accounts by segment (SMB , Mid-Market , Enterprise ) and tailor outreach through structured research and high-frequency prospecting

Maintain up-to-date forecasting and pipeline visibility through detailed reporting by stage, segment, and timeframe

Execute multi-channel outbound strategies including cold calls, emails, video messaging , and LinkedIn Sales Navigator

Consistently exceed quarterly sales goals in Total Payment Volume (TPV) , Credit Line Activation , and New Customer Acquisition

Contribute to team learning by identifying and sharing outbound tactics that work

B2B SaaS Sales Experience: Demonstrated success selling software or tech-based solutions to businesses.

Communication Excellence: Clear, confident communicator in Portuguese and English, with strong storytelling and negotiation skills.

CRM Proficiency: Familiarity withHubSpot ,Salesforce , or similar tools.

Nice to haves:

Fintech Experience: Exposure to payments, financial services, or expense management platforms.

Selling to Finance Leaders: Background working with CFOs, Controllers, or FP&A teams.

Analytical Thinking: Comfortable discussing financial metrics and business impact.

Spanish Proficiency: Or desire to grow language skills for regional collaboration.

Why join Clara

At Clara, you’ll have the autonomy, speed, and support to make meaningful impact — not just on your team, but on how organizations are run across Latin America.

Who we are

We’re the leading B2B fintech for spend management in Latin America.

Certified as one of the world's fastest-growing companies, a Great Place to Work , and a LinkedIn Top Startup .

Passionate about making Latin America more prosperous and competitive.

Constantly innovating to build financial infrastructure that enables each of our customers to thrive.

Product-led, high-talent-density culture — designed for builders who raise the bar.

Proud of our open, inclusive, and values-driven environment.

What we believe in

#Clarity. We say things clearly, directly, and proactively.

#Simplicity. We reduce noise to focus on what really matters.

#Ownership. We take responsibility and never wait to be told.

#Pride. We build products and experiences we’re proud of.

#Always Be Changing (ABC). We grow through feedback, risk-taking, and action.

#Inclusivity. Every voice counts. Everyone contributes to our mission.

What we offer

Competitive salary and stock options (ESOP ) from day one

Multicultural team with daily exposure to Portuguese, Spanish, and English (our corporate language)

Annual learning budget and internal accelerated development paths

High-ownership environment: we move fast, learn fast, and raise the bar — together

Smart, ambitious teammates — low ego, high impact

Flexible vacation and hybrid work model focused on results

If you’re ready for growth, ownership, and impact — apply now and help us redefine B2B finance in Latin America.

We don't enforce a minimum number of days for most roles, but you're expected to spend time at the office organically, and be at the office most days during your ramp-up or when required by your leader.

The employee may also need to reach, climb, balance, stoop, kneel, crouch, and maintain visual, verbal, and auditory communication both in a standard office environment and while working independently from remote locations. Principais Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e gerenciar um calendário de conteúdo mensal alinhado com os objetivos da marca, cronograma de listagens e sazonalidades.

  • Escrever legendas persuasivas para posts, destaques de imóveis, atualizações da equipe, resumos de blog e newsletters.
