  • Criar visuais no Canva (ou ferramenta similar) com identidade visual consistente.
  • Produzir ou coordenar peças de marketing como “Novo no Mercado”, “Open House” e “Vendedor”.

Gestão de Redes Sociais

  • Agendar e publicar conteúdo usando ferramentas como Meta Business Suite, Later ou Hootsuite.
  • Monitorar engajamento, responder comentários e mensagens, e cultivar uma comunidade online leal.
  • Acompanhar tendências do setor imobiliário, hashtags, formatos virais e mudanças nos algoritmos.
  • Colaborar com corretores para destacar histórias de sucesso, eventos e marcos.

Campanhas por E-mail e Mensagens Diretas

  • Criar e gerenciar campanhas segmentadas de e-mail via plataformas como Mailchimp ou Flodesk.
  • Utilizar WhatsApp para enviar listas de imóveis, novidades e manter relacionamento com leads, parceiros ou clientes antigos.
  • Manter consistência na mensagem e tom em todos os canais.

Análise, Relatórios e Otimização

  • Acompanhar KPIs como crescimento de seguidores, engajamento, taxas de abertura e cliques, geração de leads e alcance de conteúdo.
  • Sugerir melhorias baseadas em dados e testar variações de conteúdo para melhorar resultados.
  • Realizar testes A/B com diferentes tipos de posts e assuntos de e-mails.

Colaboração e Coordenação

  • Trabalhar próximo à liderança e corretores para alinhar o conteúdo com as metas do negócio.
  • Coordenação com fotógrafos, videomakers e fornecedores externos quando necessário.
  • Oferecer orientações básicas de redes sociais para membros da equipe.

Remuneração e Benefícios

  • Salário base competitivo.
  • Bônus por desempenho com base em engajamento, geração de leads e resultados.
  • Estrutura de trabalho flexível e remota.
  • Oportunidades de crescimento na área de marketing da corretora.
  • Chance de construir um portfólio de marca imobiliária de destaque.

Qualificações

  • Minimo de 2 anos de experiência em criação de conteúdo, mídias sociais ou marketing digital.
  • Excelência na escrita, atenção ao tom de voz e clareza.
  • Habilidade no uso de Canva ou Adobe, edição de vídeo (CapCut, Final Cut, Premiere, InShot, etc.).
  • Domínio de ferramentas de agendamento (Meta Suite, Later, Mailchimp, etc.).

Diferenciais

description:
Sobre a Lemon
As mudanças climáticas são um desafio complexo, mas as soluções não podem ser. Enquanto as ações climáticas forem de difícil acesso, nunca teremos um impacto unificado grande o bastante para fazer a diferença no planeta.

Sobre a Lemon
As mudanças climáticas são um desafio complexo, mas as soluções não podem ser. Enquanto as ações climáticas forem de difícil acesso, nunca teremos um impacto unificado grande o bastante para fazer a diferença no planeta.
A Lemon é o jeito mais simples para empresas e pessoas impactarem positivamente o meio ambiente por meio de uma energia mais barata e limpa. Entregamos uma energia diferente da tradicional, por isso conseguimos oferecer uma conta de luz mais econômica e sustentável. Somos comprometidos com nossos clientes e com o planeta, por isso garantimos sempre um atendimento mais próximo e inovações que incentivam mudanças no setor elétrico.
Somos apoiados pelos principais investidores em tecnologia de todo o mundo, incluindo fundos de venture capital como Kaszek, Lowercarbon Capital, Canary, Big Bets e Actyus. Endereçar um dos desafios mais significativos do mundo requer pensamento inovador e perspectivas diversas. Estamos construindo um time de pessoas com diferentes experiências, repertório profissional e formações educacionais. Se você compartilha da nossa paixão de criar essa a nova era da energia limpa, estamos ansiosos para conhecer o que de único você traz para Lemon.
Saiba mais sobre a Lemon
Sobre o time de tech:
O time de Tecnologia da Lemon é o coração da nossa inovação e crescimento. Nossa tecnologia é criada e mantida por times multidisciplinares e somos responsáveis por desenvolver soluções escaláveis e eficientes que impulsionam a nossa missão de revolucionar o setor de energia limpa. Trabalhamos em um ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo, onde a criatividade e a excelência técnica são valorizadas. No nosso backend usamos principalmente aws com node.js e microsserviços orientados a eventos assíncronos. Nosso principal banco de dados é o DynamoDB. Toda a nossa infra é serverless e criada como código. Usamos jest e github actions para nossos testes e deploys. Saiba mais sobre a nossa stack aqui.
Se você deseja fazer parte de uma equipe que está na vanguarda da tecnologia e contribuir para um futuro mais sustentável, a Lemon é o lugar certo para você.
O Que Você Vai Fazer:

  • Ter a chance real de participar da formação de uma empresa unicórnio;
  • Fazer a diferença em uma empresa que tem um dos maiores potenciais do mercado brasileiro atualmente;
  • Conseguir aplicar soluções tecnológicas que impactam positivamente o meio onde vivemos;
  • Liderar a direção técnica do time, garantindo a aplicação das melhores práticas e padrões de qualidade;
  • Representar o time de engenharia em discussões estratégicas e processos de tomada de decisão;
  • Supervisionar a arquitetura e o design de sistemas complexos, assegurando escalabilidade, estabilidade e custos;
  • Ser responsável pela formação e times de alta performance na área de tecnologia.
O perfil que buscamos:
  • Pró-atividade para resolver desafios complexos e muita vontade de fazer acontecer, passividade não faz parte deste perfil;
  • Capacidade de inspirar e motivar o time, direcionando-o para a excelência e inovação;
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, com capacidade de articular conceitos técnicos para partes interessadas não técnicas;
  • Mentalidade de ownership: responsabilidade pelo que constrói e mantém;
  • Flexibilidade para trabalhar em um ambiente dinâmico e de mudanças frequentes (somos uma startup);
  • Conexão com o impacto de negócio e entendimento do porquê por trás das soluções;
  • Comunicação clara, respeitosa e madura, com abertura para dar e receber feedback;
  • Empatia para trabalhar bem com pessoas de diferentes áreas e perfis;
  • Compromisso com o próprio desenvolvimento contínuo.
Experiência prévia / habilidades exigidas:
  • Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de software;
  • Mínimo de 2 anos atuando como líder ténico;
  • Mínimo de 2 anos de Experiência em gestão de pessoas e desenvolvimento de equipes de tecnologia;
  • Experiência comprovada na entrega de projetos de larga escala e alto impacto;
  • Forte compreensão dos princípios de desenvolvimento de software, incluindo DDD, microservices e arquiteturas baseadas em cloud;
  • Habilidade para equilibrar excelência técnica com pragmatismo e entrega de valor ao negócio.
Será um diferencial se você já tiver conhecimentos em (Não esperamos que você já conheça tudo isso, procuramos pessoas curiosas e que estejam dispostas a aprender):
  • Experiência no setor de energia e/ou em startups de rápido crescimento;
  • Conhecimento em Node.js e React;
  • Familiaridade com tecnologias de cloud computing, especialmente AWS;
  • Compreensão de desafios regulatórios e de compliance em setores regulados.
O que a gente oferece:
  • Remuneração compatível com o mercado;
  • Trabalho remoto;
  • Materiais de escritório;
  • Coworking em todo o país;
  • Cartão Caju flexível (pode ser usado nas categorias alimentação, refeição, mobilidade, educação, saúde e cultura);

  • Plano odontológico;
  • Programa de saúde mental e bem-estar (Zenklub);
  • Wellhub (Gympass);

Então, se você acredita que possui habilidades para mudar o futuro da energia no país com a gente, mas não necessariamente preenche tudo listado acima, por favor prossiga na vaga. Adoraríamos bater um papo e descobrir se você é quem estamos procurando.
Diversidade & inclusão:
Aqui na Lemon a diversidade é um compromisso ético e, por isso, estamos engajados para nos tornarmos uma empresa cada vez mais diversa e caso se sinta confortável, gostaríamos de saber na sua candidatura se auto identifica/declara pertencente a algum ou alguns grupos de diversidade.

Join to apply for the Sales Operations Analyst role at Canonical

The success of the role is measured against increasing the velocity of deals and the quality of Customer Relationship Management (CRM) data used to drive key business decisions. The ideal candidate will be a proactive problem solver and team player who is passionate about the opportunity to partner with sales leadership, is also passionate about our role in the technology industry bringing open source to a wider audience of innovators and enterprises, and will design and drive programs in support of Canonical's continued success.

  • Support all aspects of the day-to-day operations of the sales function globally
  • Review opportunities for accuracy and provision orders on successful closure of a deal
  • Support the Sales Operations Manager to improve sales data quality and processes
  • Report on data quality metrics to executive level stakeholders
  • Implement surveys and define metrics for executive level stakeholders
  • Support the sales team globally on CRM and other sales operations systems
  • Deliver sales metrics, dashboards and other ad-hoc analytical tasks
  • Lead automation and streamline the Lead to Order process
What we are looking for in you
  • An exceptional academic track record from high school and university
  • Experience in a sales operations/sales order processing role
  • Experience in a technology subscription-based business
  • Experience driving data quality improvement
  • Energetic, thoughtful, systematic approach, focused on robust, repeatable and scalable outcomes
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills
  • Ability to work productively with stakeholders at all levels of the organization on a global scale

What Canonical offers
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals.   • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. Grafana Labs is a remote-first, open-source powerhouse. There are more than 20M users of Grafana, the open source visualization tool, around the globe, monitoring everything from beehives to climate change in the Alps. The instantly recognizable dashboards have been spotted everywhere from a NASA launch and Minecraft HQ to Wimbledon and the Tour de France. Grafana Labs also helps more than 3,000 companies -- including Bloomberg, JPMorgan Chase, and eBay -- manage their observability strategies with the Grafana LGTM Stack, which can be run fully managed with Grafana Cloud or self-managed with the Grafana Enterprise Stack , both featuring scalable metrics (Grafana Mimir ), logs (Grafana Loki ), and traces (Grafana Tempo ).

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

The Opportunity:

Grafana Labs is looking for a Strategic Channel Manager, LATAM who will be responsible for developing, executing, and evolving all aspects of our partner go-to-market strategy in the Brazil region. You will work closely with the Sales, Marketing, Operations, and leadership team to align sales and go-to-market efforts with our product, technical, and sales development efforts. Your key task will be to develop and deliver immediate and future revenue growth through our partner channel, working primarily with Grafana’s Regional and Boutique Systems Integrators and Value-Added Reseller partners.

This role requires the experience to manage an emerging partner community in the region and you will be well placed to act as a trailblazer to shape the role, develop and evolve the strategy to make your mark within a rapidly growing company where partners are a core element of its GTM.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Own partner opportunity identification and deal acceleration activities to drive revenue targets
  • Lead the identification, activation and development efforts for regional partners
  • Develop partner capabilities, co-sell motions and brand awareness initiatives
  • Establish strong executive relationships to create partnership business plans
  • Work with leadership to manage pipeline and revenue commitments
  • Work across Grafana Labs to provide input on message alignment, operational coordination, and evangelism of the partner strategy and program

What Makes You a Great Fit:

  • 7+ years of experience in channel sales
  • Experience selling SaaS and/or open source technology is a plus
  • Demonstrated history of consistent goal achievement at high growth startups
  • Experience in consultative sales approach with the primary goal of maintaining exceptionally high levels of customer, partner, and community satisfaction
  • Proven experience developing a high performing Channels strategy
  • Located in Brazil

Bonus Points For:

  • Experience with Open Source technologies, or in the Metrics/Monitoring space
  • Experience in working in a remote setting

Compensation & Rewards:

In the Brazil the OTE (On-Target Earnings) compensation range for this role is BRL 1,168,650 - BRL 1,272,530. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.

  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer: We will recruit, train, compensate and promote regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, disability, age, veteran status, and all the other fascinating characteristics that make us different and unique. Who are we?

At Pure , we are dedicated to transforming lives by creating high-quality supplements backed by science and trusted by our growing community. Our mission is to make achieving better health simpler, more effective, and more accessible for everyone. Since our launch, we’ve scaled rapidly through viral digital marketing and built a passionate customer base that loves and trusts our products. We operate with a small but mighty team that thrives on innovation, data-driven growth, and relentless creativity—and we’re excited to bring on a Creative Strategist to play a pivotal role in scaling our brand even further.

What is our culture like & who is a good fit?

Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We utilize creativity to do more with less - and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by the following three core values : "work smart", "overdeliver", "speed is king" and "better everyday". We love learning - every problem is an opportunity to grow. If you want a stress-free corporate 9-5 job, this isn’t it.

If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast-growing company, work directly with the founders- and play a huge role in scaling it to $12M+ a year. Drive results with a group of passionate, smart & hardworking fun people. Work in an environment without politics, or corporate chicanery. Play a big part in our growth being hands on, active, and doing what is necessary with an excellent bonus plan based on performance then you have come to the right place.

Key Objectives

  • Manage the full creative process (from scripting all the way to final creative) in order to produce high converting creatives on an ongoing basis.
  • Work with our content manager to find, manage and source new content to be used across all marketing channels
  • Drive measurable improvements in core advertising metrics across digital channels with improved creatives.
  • Script UGC Direct response creatives
  • Use data from creative performance on Meta to dissect, analyze and improve upon our creatives to continuously improve performance across our creatives.
  • Work with our marketing team to come up with new creative concepts and ideas.
  • Conduct strategic customer and competitor research to better optimize creative efforts
  • Provide creative reports on a monthly and quarterly basis
  • Decide on the next steps needed to scale Meta Ads further through better creative

Requirements

  • Direct Response Expertise : 3+ Years Experience with performance creative for DTC brands or working at a creative agency is a must.

  • UGC Experience : Lots of experience with creating briefs for UGC creators to produce high converting content across paid channels.
  • Creative & Analytical Mindset : Ability to generate fresh ideas, write scripts, shot listing, and make data-driven decisions based on ad performance.
  • No issue working overtime or on the weekends if needed. You wouldn’t know what to do with your free time if you were working less. You are passionate about your work.
  • Excellent cultural fit as per our values above.
  • Are excited to play a big role in scaling the company and work closely with the founders.
  • Basic psychology-based copywriting skills

Accountabilities

About Acadia Pharmaceuticals

Acadia is advancing breakthroughs in neuroscience to elevate life. Since our founding, we have been working at the forefront of healthcare to bring vital solutions to people who need them most. We developed and commercialized the first and only FDA-approved drug to treat hallucinations and delusions associated with Parkinson's disease psychosis, and the first and only approved drug in the United States and Canada for the treatment of Rett syndrome. Our clinical-stage development efforts are focused on Prader-Willi syndrome, Alzheimer's disease psychosis, and multiple other programs targeting neuro-psychiatric and neuro-rare diseases. For more information, visit Acadia.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Seeking Talent Near: Miami, FL; Westchester, FL

Position Summary

The Neuroscience Sales Specialist is responsible for achieving sales goals within the assigned territory by building strong customer relationships, delivering compliant and compelling product education, and driving appropriate patient access. This role requires expertise in neuroscience, deep knowledge of the local healthcare landscape, and the ability to partner effectively with healthcare professionals (HCPs) and key stakeholders to deliver meaningful value and service.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Promote Acadia products to HCPs in person and virtually, providing clinical, disease state, and reimbursement information in a compliant and customer-focused manner.
  • Develop and execute a territory business plan to meet or exceed sales objectives, leveraging market data, customer insights, and quarterly action plans.
  • Establish and maintain strong relationships with HCPs, including key opinion leaders, advocacy organizations, and other healthcare stakeholders.
  • Address customer questions, concerns, and objections using advanced dialogue and selling skills.
  • Tailor approved sales aids, clinical reprints, and brand resources to meet specific customer needs.
  • Partner with internal colleagues (e.g., managed markets, operations, sales training, marketing) to deliver coordinated solutions.
  • Provide guidance on product pricing, reimbursement, and specialty distribution channels, acting as a liaison between customers and the Company for access-related issues.
  • Accurately track and report sales activities, business expenses, and customer interactions in a timely manner.
  • Represent Acadia at conferences, exhibits, and trainings; participate in national, regional, and local meetings as required.
  • Mentor and train new sales specialists as needed, and contribute to cross-functional projects and field strategic insights.

Knowledge & Expertise

  • Deep understanding of neuroscience disease states, Acadia products, and local/regional market dynamics.
  • Ability to serve as a trusted resource in the medical community.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and virtual engagement platforms (e.g., Zoom, WebEx).
  • Strong grasp of payer dynamics, including Part D and specialty pharmacy/hub distribution.

Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor's degree required; life sciences preferred.
  • Experience:
    • Sales Specialist : Minimum 1+ years of sales experience in pharmaceutical/healthcare; neuroscience preferred.
    • Senior Specialist : Minimum 5+ years of healthcare sales (2+ in complex/account-based selling).
  • Demonstrated advanced selling skills, leadership abilities, and business acumen.
  • Proven success in influencing diverse HCP audiences across multiple care settings.
  • Strong interpersonal, communication, and negotiation skills.
  • Ability to work independently, adapt to change, and deliver consistently high results.

Background

Keeping Children Safe sets International Child Safeguarding Standards to help organisations protect children from abuse in organisations across the world.

We are completely independent and guided by the best interests of the child principle in all that we do. We work with people who have been subjected to child abuse, researchers, practitioners, policymakers and leaders to defend children’s right to be safe in all organisations, no matter how big or powerful.

This newly created role in our Standards and Learning team will lead on the development and implementation of a new child-safeguarding programme in Brazil, as well as contribute to the development of Keeping Children Safe globally.

Key responsibilities will include:

  • Developing and implementing a new child-safeguarding programme in Brazil.
  • Providing high-quality, technical advice on child safeguarding to Keeping Children Safe members and partners.
  • Providing technical input on child safeguarding to programme development and fundraising proposals.
  • Representing Keeping Children Safe with key stakeholders.
  • Supporting the development and implementation of tools, resources and frameworks for programmatic monitoring, evaluation and learning.
  • Undertaking any other reasonable duty and tasks that may from time-to-time be requested by the line manager consistent with the nature of the job and its level of responsibility.

Person specification:

  • Substantial experience of designing, managing, monitoring and evaluating child-safeguarding initiatives, gained in law enforcement, social work or humanitarian and development organisations.
  • A deep understanding and experience of accompanying organisations in Brazil to embed contextually appropriate child safeguarding measures.
  • Professional level Portuguese and English.
  • Experience of programme development and monitoring, evaluation and learning.
  • Significant track record of delivering training at all levels from community to international.
  • Exceptional facilitation and public speaking skills, ability to inspire others to make significant change.
  • Skilled at identifying and mitigating risks.
  • Proven ability to build, manage and develop key stakeholder, client and donor relationships.
  • Excellent written communication skills including report writing and conducting evaluations.
  • Evidence of Continued Professional Development relevant to the role purpose and level.
  • Able and willing to travel.
  • A proven commitment to child safeguarding, child rights and child participation.
  • A commitment to the vision, aims and approach of the organisation.
  • A commitment to non-discrimination, respect and dignity for all.
  • A team player, able to manage their own workload as well as, work with and support others and deliver to agreed standards and targets.
  • An entrepreneurial, positive, solution-focused approach to work.
  • Integrity with appropriate ethics and behaviours.
  • Experience of leading child-safeguarding investigations.

The Appointment

  • The appointment will be for three days per week.
  • The leave allowance is 25 working days per annum pro rata.
  • In view of the nature of the work involved, any offer of appointment will be conditional upon receipt of satisfactory references and Disclosure and Barring Service/Police checks.

Applications

To apply for this post and to be considered for an interview please apply with your CV and a covering letter addressing each point in the person specification to Helen Carter, Head of Finance and Operations:

Interviews will take place on a rolling basis. The position is open until filled.

Safeguarding statement

Keeping Children Safe has a zero-tolerance approach to any harm, exploitation or abuse of anyone including our staff and stakeholders. Safeguarding forms an intrinsic part of everything that we do. Recruitment to any jobs within KCS will include criminal record checks and the receipt of satisfactory references. Compliance with all our Child Safeguarding Policies and Procedures is mandatory.

title: Salesforce Data Migration Specialist
description:
About Us :

Kelley Austin takes a different approach to Salesforce Consulting by putting our employees first. That’s not hyperbole, either. Our team takes a proactive approach to employee satisfaction by having every single person fill out a “happiness list,” which comprises the top ten things each employee finds happiness in outside of work.

We review those happiness lists regularly to ensure everyone is checking most of the boxes and adjust their project load, responsibilities, or schedule accordingly if not.

Look at our benefits and perks below to learn more about our culture.

We’re growing fast (more than doubling YOY) but staying diligent in hiring the best possible people who don’t just want a job, but will actually care about the success of their co-workers and clients.

Our growth, coupled with the distinction of being recognized as the 'fastest Salesforce Implementation Partner to achieve Platinum / Summit status,' attests to the success of our approach.

Take a look at the ‘About You’ and ‘Responsibilities’ below to learn more :

Benefits

  • Base Salary
  • Work From Home Flexibility
  • Flexible PTO (we treat people like adults here)
  • Paid Holidays (including an entire week off around Christmas and New Year)

Tools We Use

  • As a technology software consulting company, we use many tools, but the big four are Google Drive, Slack, Lucid Chart, and Salesforce, of course.

Perks Of The Job

  • You won’t really find egos here. We hire slowly and purposefully to keep our culture strong and our team cohesive.
  • We don’t say yes to every client and are not afraid to part ways with a client, either. If there’s no mutual respect or success involved, we politely decline and help them find a different partner. That means fewer ‘tough’ clients and more clients who “get it” and work harmoniously together.
  • We offer half a dozen different clubs like book club, health club, movie club, hobby club, and more. These bring people together to grow intellectually and get to know one another outside of project work.
  • We work an average of 40 hours per week (I know, that’s unheard of in consulting, but we stand by it).

About You

We are seeking a Data Migration Specialist with deep hands-on expertise in Salesforce, Salesforce SOQL, Salesforce APEX, relational databases, SQL, scripting, and large-scale data migration. This role is highly execution-focused and detail-oriented — you will be designing and running ETL processes, writing queries and scripts, validating data quality, and ensuring successful end-to-end migrations between enterprise systems.

Responsibilities

  • Plan, execute, and manage end-to-end data migration projects, including extraction, transformation, loading, and validation.
  • Write and optimize complex SQL and SOQL queries for data validation, migration, and reconciliation.
  • Build, configure, and run ETL jobs to move and transform data across Salesforce, ERP, and external databases.
  • Develop and maintain automation scripts (APEX, Python, Shell, PowerShell, or similar) for data processing, cleansing, and quality checks.
  • Perform data profiling, mapping, and transformation to meet business and technical requirements.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve migration issues such as data mismatches, performance bottlenecks, and integrity errors.
  • Collaborate with internal and external Salesforce, integration, and business teams to coordinate cutovers and validate migrated data.
  • Document migration procedures, scripts, mappings, and reconciliation steps for repeatability and compliance.
  • Ensure all migrations follow best practices for data quality, security, and governance.

Required Technical and Professional Expertise

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent hands-on experience).
  • 5+ years of direct experience in data migration, ETL, or database engineering roles.
  • Strong technical expertise in relational databases (Salesforce, Oracle, SQL Server, or similar).
  • Advanced proficiency in SQL (query optimization, joins, stored procedures).
  • Practical experience with Salesforce SOQL, APEX, and Salesforce data model.
  • Proven track record in data migration projects, including reconciliation and cutover planning.
  • Hands-on scripting skills in Python, Shell, PowerShell, or similar.
  • Familiarity with ETL tools, APIs, and bulk data processing.
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) is a plus.
  • Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and ability to deliver under tight deadlines.

NOTE : Kelley Austin will not be able to sponsor applicants for work visas.

Aqui na ed, o que mais valorizamos é a nossa cultura. Por isso, iniciamos o nosso processo com o preenchimento de um rápido mapeamento de perfil, aplicado logo após a inscrição. Com esse mapeamento, identificamos o quanto temos em comum no que tange à Cultura Organizacional. Todos que apresentarem o mínimo de Fit Cultural necessário seguem para a próxima etapa. Aqui, valorizamos suas características pessoais, sem importar sua idade, gênero, formação, etc.

Se você topa o desafio, venha fazer parte do nosso time. Estamos focados em qualidade e resultado, com tecnologias de ponta, em um ambiente colaborativo. Pensamos e agimos como um time, desde o problema até a solução. Aqui somos um só, onde o problema de um é o problema de todos.

Criamos softwares, soluções tecnológicas e impulsionamos pessoas, negócios, sociedade e o mundo.

Estamos contratando Analista QA Pleno para fazer parte do nosso time!

Responsabilidades e Atribuições

  1. Criar planos de testes detalhados, incluindo casos de teste, fluxos de trabalho e critérios de aceitação.
  2. Definir a estratégia de testes, selecionando as ferramentas e abordagens adequadas (manual ou automatizado) para garantir a cobertura dos cenários críticos.
  3. Realizar testes manuais exploratórios para identificar falhas que possam não ser cobertas pelos testes automatizados.
  4. Colaborar com times de desenvolvimento, produto e stakeholders para entender os requisitos e especificações dos projetos.
  5. Garantir que as entregas atendam aos padrões de qualidade estabelecidos.
  6. Participar ativamente do processo de melhoria contínua, sugerindo novas abordagens e metodologias de teste.
  7. Analisar os resultados dos testes e criar relatórios detalhados de qualidade e desempenho.
  8. Priorizar e acompanhar a resolução de problemas junto à equipe de desenvolvimento.
  9. Fornecer feedback contínuo sobre a qualidade do código e a eficácia das correções.

Requisitos e qualificações

O que amplia as suas chances:

  • Seu fit cultural.

O que não pode faltar:

  • Experiência de pelo menos 3 anos como Analista de QA ou cargos relacionados.
  • Conhecimento sólido em testes de software, incluindo testes funcionais, de regressão, de carga e de performance.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de automação de testes.
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) e práticas de DevOps.
  • Habilidades analíticas e atenção aos detalhes para identificar problemas e áreas de melhoria.
  • Boa comunicação e habilidade para trabalhar de forma colaborativa em equipes multidisciplinares.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com testes de APIs usando ferramentas como Postman ou SoapUI.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de CI/CD (ex.: Jenkins, GitLab CI).
  • Experiência com ambientes de nuvem (AWS, Azure ou GCP).
  • Capacidade de realizar testes de desempenho para avaliar o comportamento sob carga e estresse, usando ferramentas como JMeter, Gatling, LoadRunner, entre outras.
  • Certificações na área de QA ou testes de software.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de IA para aumentar a produtividade será considerada um diferencial.

This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

  • Act as the primary point of contact for communication between talent who are hired on client engagements and internal Toptal stakeholders.

  • Assist in account administration items by collaborating with the Finance and Legal teams to ensure compliance with specific account’s requirements.
  • Organize and update process guidelines, making them easily accessible for team reference.
  • Assist in onboarding new team members to ensure a smooth integration process.
  • Support the completion of ad-hoc strategic projects, as needed.

Expectations by Milestone

  • First week : Onboard and integrate into Toptal; familiarize yourself with Toptal’s culture, history and vision; learn team tools, processes and reporting mechanisms; gain proficiency with Toptal’s platform.
  • First month : Understand team processes, policies and content repository; familiarize yourself with various teams at Toptal and their contributions to company success; begin executing tasks with support from other team members.

  • First six months : Start making your own contributions to our strategies by having a full grasp of the role, while exercising discretion and independent judgment; be an integral part of the Matching team’s success.
  • First year : Act as a subject matter expert on the Matching Operations Coordinator role.

Qualifications and Job Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree is required.
  • At least 2 years of experience in coordination, operations support, or customer support roles.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, as well as perfect grammar and command of the English language. Good communication is at the core of everything we do, and you must be a strong communicator to be able to work successfully with a wide range of stakeholders.
  • Excellent organization skills and detail-oriented. You are hyper-organized, know how to work efficiently, and prioritize execution.
  • Proficiency in Google Sheets and Google Docs for data processing and presentation.
  • You should be a self-starter who thrives on accountability and managing your own workflow, tasks, and assigned accounts.
  • You need to be able to follow processes expertly. When faced with limited data, you need to be able to make decisions that follow given guidelines.
  • Adaptability. Our processes and priorities may evolve rapidly. You need to be able to learn and adapt to change quickly.
  • Willingness to collaborate, share knowledge, and learn from teammates.
  • Continuous Improvement. You need to have an eye for continuous improvement and be open to receiving challenging feedback.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.
  • You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

Join to apply for the Estagiário De Designer Gráfico - Oportunidade De Crescimento Profissional! role at CB Marketing Boutique

Atenção: Esta é uma vaga de estágio.

Você é uma pessoa disponível, responsável, proativa, criativa, organizada e cheia de vontade de aprender?

Venha fazer parte do nosso time!

  • Auxiliar na criação de arte para diversas mídias digitais, tais como Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, e-mail marketing, folders, cartões de visita, entre outros.

Será proporcionado treinamento e acompanhamento por um profissional experiente para garantir um desenvolvimento eficaz.

  • Conhecimento básico em marketing digital;
  • Entendimento de Pacotes Office, Facebook e Instagram;
  • Muita responsabilidade, organização e atenção aos detalhes;
  • Capacidade de gerenciar várias tarefas simultaneamente;
  • Responsabilidade e capacidade de se auto-gerenciar, assegurando o cumprimento de prazos e metas estabelecidos.
  • Conhecimento básico em edição de imagem e vídeo, com bom senso estético;
  • Boa comunicação para trabalho em equipe;
  • Familiaridade com programas de edição como Photoshop, Canva, Corel.
  • Familiaridade com sistemas de monitoramento de desempenho será valorizada.

Responsabilidades

  • Auxiliar na criação de layouts para posts em todas as plataformas digitais;
  • Edição de vídeos para reels, timeline, YouTube, Instagram, Facebook e TikTok;
  • Criação de peças digitais com direcionamento do superior;
  • Desenvolvimento de conteúdo criativo para posts de Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, Pinterest e TikTok;
  • Agendamento de posts em todas as plataformas;
  • Criação e envio de e-mail marketing.
  • Auxiliar em tarefas diversas

Como Se Candidatar

Se você é apaixonado pelo mundo do marketing digital, está disposto a aprender e deseja fazer parte de nossa equipe, envie seu currículo e uma breve carta de apresentação com o assunto: Estagiário de Criação - Seu Nome. Destaque seu interesse pela vaga, acrescente exemplos de artes que você já tenha produzido e destaque o seu potencial para crescer como um membro valioso de nossa equipe.

Estamos ansiosos para receber sua candidatura e ajudá-lo a desenvolver suas habilidades em Design Gráfico.

Quem Somos

Somos uma agência de marketing digital totalmente online, com atendimento voltado para nichos específicos de mercado. Possuímos vasta experiência e excelência nos serviços que oferecemos. Trabalhamos com dedicação e paixão e buscamos pessoas que gostem de trabalhar, tenham interesse em comunicação, sejam criativas e não tenham medo de enfrentar novos desafios. Valorizamos profissionais éticos e responsáveis, dispostos a somar ao nosso time. Acreditamos na importância da diversidade e inclusão e encorajamos candidaturas de pessoas com diferentes histórias, representando a pluralidade do nosso país. Acreditamos que uma equipe formada por indivíduos diversos nos torna mais criativos e inovadores. Será que você é a pessoa que estamos procurando?

title: Produtor de Conteúdo para Marketing Digital
description:
Overview


Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Content Producer focada em vídeo e marketing digital , capaz de liderar a criação e organização de um alto volume de conteúdos em múltiplos formatos e canais. O desafio é grande: garantir consistência, qualidade e escala na produção de mais de 100 criativos por mês para Meta (cobrindo tanto anúncios pagos quanto canais orgânicos), além de outros materiais de marketing.


Esse papel vai além de escrever — envolve produção de vídeo, coordenação de freelancers e criadores de UGC, uso de ferramentas de IA para otimizar processos e entrega de conteúdos que realmente impactem em performance e crescimento.


Se você gosta de unir criatividade e organização, domina fluxos de produção audiovisual, tem paixão por tecnologia e entende como transformar ideias em conteúdos envolventes e eficazes, essa vaga é para você.



What you will do



  • Produzir e organizar conteúdos em vídeo e formatos digitais, com foco em performance de marketing (anúncios pagos, orgânico, social media, YouTube, etc.).

  • Escalar produção de criativos: coordenar a criação de mais de 100 peças por mês para campanhas em Meta (Facebook/Instagram), com variedade de estilos e formatos.

  • Gerenciar processos e pipeline de conteúdo: estruturar calendários, fluxos de aprovação e entregas de alto volume.

  • Usar ferramentas de IA (ex.: ChatGPT, Descript, Midjourney, Runway) para acelerar roteiros, edições e variações criativas.

  • Trabalhar com freelancers e UGC creators (roteiristas, editores de vídeo, designers), garantindo qualidade, prazo e alinhamento à estratégia de marca.

  • Criar e revisar materiais de marketing além de vídeos — como apresentações, PDFs e peças de suporte a vendas.

  • Aprovar e otimizar conteúdos: revisar qualidade, clareza, consistência de marca e potencial de performance.



Qualifications



  • Experiência comprovada em produção de vídeo para marketing digital (YouTube, anúncios para Meta, podcasts, webinars, etc.).

  • Vivência na coordenação de alto volume de criativos e organização de processos de produção.

  • Experiência na criação de conteúdo para marketing e vendas (não apenas conteúdo educativo).

  • Habilidade para gerenciar freelancers e criadores de UGC.

  • Experiência prática com ferramentas de IA aplicadas à criação de conteúdo.

  • Boa noção de tecnologia, programação básica ou cultura tech.

  • Excelente organização e gestão de projetos.

  • Inglês avançado.



Diferenciais



  • Experiência em EdTech, SaaS ou produtos baseados em IA.

  • Conhecimento de métricas de performance de conteúdo e capacidade de ajustar estratégias com base em dados.

  • Familiaridade com storytelling visual, design ou motion graphics.



What we can offer you



  • Trabalho 100% remoto, com flexibilidade e equilíbrio;

  • Contratação PJ com salário fixo em dólar;

  • Descanso remunerado (férias e feriados nacionais);

  • Oportunidade de gerar impacto real e direto nos resultados da empresa, contribuindo ativamente para o nosso crescimento;

  • Um time diverso e distribuído pelo mundo, com pessoas nos EUA, América Latina, Brasil, Sérvia, Geórgia e em mais de 10 outros países.

title: CONSULTOR COMERCIAL PLENO
description:
A Eurofins Scientific é uma empresa internacional de ciências da vida que fornece uma gama única de serviços de testes analíticos para clientes em vários setores. O Grupo acredita que é o líder mundial em análises de produtos alimentícios e farmacêuticos, matrizes ambientais e em serviços de CRO de agrosciences . É também um dos líderes de mercados independentes globais para de certos testes e serviços laboratoriais para genômica, pesquisa farmacológica, ciência forense, ciências de materiais avançadas e para apoio a estudos clínicos. Além disso, a Eurofins é um dos principais players emergentes em testes de diagnóstico clínico especializados na Europa e nos EUA.

Os números-chave do grupo são aproximadamente: Faturamento de 3,8 bilhões de euros, mais de 800 laboratórios em 47 países e cerca de 45.000 funcionários.

Descrição do emprego

Realizar prospecção de clientes, negociação e fechamento de contratos através visitas no ambiente nacional, oferecendo produtos de acordo com as reais necessidades, prestando excelente atendimento, visando atração e retenção de novos clientes e aumento da lucratividade da empresa, bem como o cumprimento das metas estabelecidas pela gerência da área.

  • Participar da elaboração do Plano de Negócios Anual para atender as metas da empresa;
  • Dar suporte ao Consultor Comercial Júnior;
  • Realizar de forma ativa a prospecção de clientes, visitas e viagens;
  • Prospectar listas para geração de leads e auxiliar na descrição de informações de qualificação;
  • Visitar clientes para garantir a manutenção da carteira da empresa;
  • Realizar “Follow up” diário das propostas enviadas;
  • Qualificar as necessidades dos clientes em casos complexos e/ou Top Clients da sua carteira.
  • Realizar análise crítica de contrato nas solicitações de propostas recebidas e encaminha as informações para que os Assistentes e Analistas Comerciais (SA) enviem as propostas;
  • Cobrar o registro das propostas enviadas no CRM;
  • Realizar FUP das propostas no CRM;
  • Monitorar KPIs semanalmente junto ao Gerente Comercial;
  • Negociar ativamente as Oportunidades dentro de sua faixa de autoridade;
  • Gerenciar as interações entre cliente e a Eurofins durante as negociações junto com BUMAs e ASMs;
  • Acompanha Novos negócios e mercado ativamente, como exemplo eventos, visitas, redes sociais;
  • Orientar Assistentes e Analistas Comerciais (SA) nas prioridades e nos relacionamentos com os setores de apoio (amostragem, login, logout, invoices);
  • Elaborar e negociar propostas comerciais. Negocia ativamente as Oportunidades dentro de sua faixa de autoridade;
  • Realizar o atendimento dos clientes pessoalmente, por telefone ou e-mail;
  • Realizar visitas mensais aos clientes garantindo a continuidade dos contratos e buscando novas vendas dentro dos clientes (reunião de follow up, renegociações contratuais, estratégia de fidelização, divulgação de novos métodos e soluções Eurofins);
  • Acompanhar os clientes em todas as fases do ciclo do negócio da empresa: elaboração e envio da proposta, negociação e fechamento, faturamento, recebimento e pós-venda;
  • Garantir a satisfação do cliente dentro das metas de fidelidade estabelecidas pela empresa;
  • Elaborar relatórios comerciais para dar suporte às atividades de planejamento da empresa;
  • Cumprir suas metas de vendas individuais e do ticket médio das análises;
  • Executar outras atividades correlatas, conforme necessidade, ou a critério de seu superior.

Qualificações

Dinamismo, comunicação, foco no cliente, relacionamento interpessoal, pró-atividade, comprometimento.

Graduação completa em Meio Ambiente, Química, Ciências dos Alimentos, Agronomia, Farmácia, Biologia, Veterinária, Zootecnia, Engenharia Química, Nutrição, Marketing, Administração ou Gestão de Negócios.

Especialização é um diferencial.

Inglês intermediário.

De Segunda a Sexta - dás 08:00 às 17:00 - Trabalho 100% remoto

description:
As a Customer Success Analyst at Weni by VTEX , you will ensure that clients successfully adopt and extract value from the Weni Platform. You will combine relationship management with hands-on technical knowledge, guiding clients to use the platform effectively and embedding Weni’s solutions into their daily operations.

What you will do

  • Drive Product Adoption: Guide clients through configuration, workflows, and integrations to ensure they fully leverage the Weni Platform.
  • Technical Enablement: Provide technical support and guidance on platform features, best practices, and optimizations to improve client operations.
  • Client Engagement & Expansion: Build strong relationships with clients, including C-Level executives, to identify growth opportunities, negotiate renewals, and promote upsells.
  • Strategic Meetings: Lead sessions with clients to align their goals with Weni’s capabilities, addressing technical and operational challenges.
  • Monitor Customer Health: Track engagement, anticipate risks, and proactively implement solutions to maximize value and reduce churn.
  • Collaboration with Internal Teams: Work closely with Solution Engineering, Product, and Support teams to resolve issues and ensure a smooth client experience.

Who you are

  • You are technically proficient, able to understand platform features, integrations, and workflows, and translate that knowledge into actionable guidance for clients.
  • You adapt and learn quickly, thriving in dynamic environments.
  • You approach problems with a technical and analytical mindset, simplifying complex challenges for clients.
  • You have knowledge and/or experience in Retail, Marketplace, Digital Commerce, or Omnichannel, understanding how these areas impact adoption and customer experience.
  • You have experience in Customer Success, Technical Account Management, or Solution Engineering.
  • You are fluent in English and comfortable communicating with global clients; Spanish is a plus.
  • You are proactive, organized, and driven to help clients succeed with Weni’s solutions.

About VTEX

VTEX (NYSE: VTEX) is the composable and complete commerce platform that delivers more efficiency and less maintenance to organizations seeking to make smarter IT investments and modernize their tech stack. Through our pragmatic composability approach, we empower brands, distributors, and retailers with unparalleled flexibility and comprehensive solutions, enabling them to invest solely in what provides a clear business advantage and boosts profitability. VTEX is trusted by 2,400 global B2C and B2B customers, including Carrefour, Colgate, Motorola, Sony, Stanley Black & Decker, and Whirlpool, having 3,400 active online stores across 43 countries (as of FY ended on December 31, 2024).

Founded in the year 2000, VTEX has a history of being unstoppable. Completely against the odds, VTEX is leading a high-tech industry and positioned above market giants. We are building an extraordinary future with more than 1,300 employees scattered across 25 locations in 16 countries in Latin America, North America, Europe, and Asia. For more information, visit

At VTEX, you will work in a challenge-driven environment and collaborate with amazing peers. If you are powerful individually, join us, and we will be unstoppable together.

About Weni by VTEX

Weni by VTEX is a business unit of VTEX dedicated to enterprise customer experience solutions powered by artificial intelligence, designed for brands and retailers.

With the Weni Platform, we redefine sales and post-sales journeys through hyperautomation and the smart integration of data into conversational channels, delivering faster, more personalized, and more efficient experiences for consumers.

title: Social Media Specialist – Remote (Brazil)
description:
Overview


We’re seeking a highly organized and experienced Social Media Specialist (Remote) living in Curitiba, Brazil to join the Marketing team at High Tide Inc. , one of the largest cannabis companies in the world. With brands like Daily High Club , Smoke Cartel , Grasscity , and Canna Cabana , we’re leading the way in cannabis accessories and CBD e-commerce across North America and Europe.


We’re looking for someone who knows how to build a brand voice, plan a content calendar, and work with influencers, all while keeping up with the latest social trends. If you’ve got a sharp eye for meme content, know your way around simple edits using CapCut, and can make followers laugh and click—then this role is for you!



Responsibilities



  • Plan and manage the monthly content calendar across multiple brand social channels (IG, TikTok, FB)

  • Support day-to-day posting and engagement, ensuring brand voice is consistent and on trend

  • Work with influencers and creators each month - sourcing, briefing, coordinating, and tracking posts

  • Stay on top of social trends and recommend new content formats, meme ideas, and platform experiments

  • Collaborate with design, copy, and email teams to align messaging and campaign timing

  • Track and report on key metrics to senior management, to help optimize content and influencer performance

  • Create or edit simple short-form content (e.g. memes, trending sound videos) using tools like CapCut (bonus)

  • 4-5 years of experience managing social content for consumer-facing brands, ideally in e-commerce, lifestyle, or youth-driven categories

  • Confident handling multiple brands and social voices in a fast-paced environment

  • Proven track record managing influencer content and relationships

  • Experience in creating weekly/monthly social reports and presenting to stakeholders

  • A good sense of humor and an understanding of meme and trend culture

  • Experience using CapCut or mobile tools to put together simple video or meme content (bonus)

  • Strong communicator and organized collaborator across remote teams



Why Join High Tide



  • Shape the online voice of globally recognized cannabis and CBD brands

  • Work with a fully remote, fast-moving team that’s supportive and collaborative (Toronto hours)

  • Collaborate across departments and get visibility into brand, creative, and growth strategy

  • Bring your creativity to a space that values originality, humor, and measurable results

  • Make your mark at one of the largest cannabis & accessory company in the world, driving growth through engaging content



How To Apply


Please include the following with your application



  • Your resume in English

  • Portfolio min. 2-3 examples of social content or brand accounts you’ve worked on (posts, videos, memes, content calendars etc.)

  • (Optional but encouraged) - examples of influencer management (i.e content and/or results)



If you’re ready to create scroll-stopping content and grow brands to the next level—we’d love to hear from you.



High Tide Inc. is the leading community-grown, retail-forward cannabis enterprise engineered to unleash the full value of the world’s most powerful plant and is the second-largest cannabis retailer globally by store count. High Tide (HITI) is uniquely-built around the cannabis consumer, with wholly-diversified and fully-integrated operations across all components of cannabis, including



  • Bricks & Mortar Retail Canna Cabana is the largest cannabis retail chain in Canada, with 200 plus current locations spanning British Columbia, Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, Ontario and growing. In 2021, Canna Cabana became the first cannabis discount club retailer in the world.

  • Retail Innovation Fastendr is a unique and fully automated technology that employs retail kiosks to facilitate a better buying experience through browsing, ordering and pickup.

  • Consumption Accessories High Tide operates a suite of leading accessory e-commerce platforms across the world, including Grasscity.com, Smokecartel.com, Dailyhighclub.com, and Dankstop.com.

  • E-commerce Platforms High Tide operates a suite of leading accessory sites across the world, including Grasscity.com, Smokecartel.com, Dailyhighclub.com, and Dankstop.com.



CBD High Tide continues to cultivate the possibilities of consumer CBD through Nuleafnaturals.com, FABCBD.com, blessedcbd.de and blessedcbd.co.uk.


Wholesale Distribution High Tide keeps that cannabis category stocked with wholesale solutions via Valiant.


Licensing High Tide continues to push cannabis culture forward through fresh partnerships and license agreements under the Famous Brandz name.


High Tide consistently moves ahead of the currents, having been named one of Canada’s Top Growing Companies in 2021, 2022, 2023 and 2024 by the Globe and Mail’s Report on Business Magazine, and was named as one of the top 10 performing diversified industries stocks in both 2022 and 2024 TSX Venture 50. title: Business Services Team Manager
description:
Overview

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in more than 80 countries and very few roles based in offices.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring a Business Services Team Manager to lead efficient and effective travel, logistics, event, scheduling, expense policy and administration.

This executive role requires outstanding coordination, planning, decision-making, budgeting, procurement, reporting and management. It is a fast-paced and complex operation in the tech industry.

We coordinate large-scale company events which involve travel for hundreds of people from 80+ countries. We run such events four times a year, a significant investment in our ability to shape culture, teamwork, execution plans and strategy. Our team is responsible for travel procurement and logistics, ensuring that these events run efficiently and safely. Visas, travel complications and unexpected situations make this a complex operation to run efficiently, demanding a rigorous approach and high work ethic in the team.

This team also serves as an independent check on expense claim approval, ensuring fairness and consistency across teams and countries. This requires integrity, transparency and accountability, and a willingness to set and politely defend the same expectations of the most senior and most junior colleagues.

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. title: Mechanical & Plumbing BIM Specialist
description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Mechanical & Plumbing BIM Specialist role at ENG .

The Role

The BIM Specialist role covers modeling of different trades (MEP), depending on background and project scope (specific zones or entire buildings). Responsibilities include ensuring high-quality modeling (expertise, technical knowledge, LOD and QAQC) with autonomy in self-management. A BIM Specialist helps clients by detecting conflicts during the initial information review, modeling, and coordination phases.

Minimum mandatory requirements

  • Excellent level of English is an absolute must, both spoken and written. Candidates must be able to engage in fluent conversations with native and non-native speakers. Candidates without this requirement will NOT be considered.
  • Solid experience modeling HVAC and plumbing in Revit for commercial, industrial, healthcare, and residential construction. This includes process piping, ductwork, sheet metal, mechanical equipment (pumps, AHUs, RTUs, chillers, boilers), and plumbing (domestic water, sanitary drainage, gray water, stormwater, medical gases, compressed air lines, pumps, heaters, and hangers).
  • Experience coordinating or clash-detecting through Navisworks (Revizto considered but Navisworks preferred); knowledge of BIM coordination, clash reports, QAQC, and model accuracy.
  • A mechanical or civil engineering bachelor’s degree (architects could be considered if they have extensive experience modeling and coordinating MEP trades).

Desirable/Additional requirements

Specific requirements vary by position and service. Experience with LOD 400 and projects based in the US , or constructability knowledge related to that country, is a huge differential . Other desirable items include:

  • Familiarity with BIM add-ins (e.g., Evolve , SysQue , Fabrication Parts ).
  • Experience in conceptual design / BIM design assist.
  • AutoCAD Plant 3D knowledge.
  • Dynamo/Python knowledge applied to BIM.
  • On-site/field experience .
  • Ability to produce detailed models, including real-world fittings and connection types .

Please note: if you don’t have experience working with Revit in formal jobs, it will be hard to be considered. Also, please ensure your English level meets the requirement.

About ENG

Who we are: ENG (engbim.com) is a BIM company that specializes in hands-on, field-focused BIM services. Founded in 2007, we are the largest and most experienced BIM production service provider in the United States, having completed 5,000 BIM projects with a dedicated team of over 500 staff members. We provide MEP Modeling, VDC/BIM Management, Laser Scanning, and Scan to BIM services, as well as a comprehensive array of BIM production services to architects, engineers, and owners.

Work arrangements & Benefits

  • Work from Anywhere: Flexibility to work remotely or from a coworking space.
  • Paid time off: Flexible paid time off when you need it.
  • Wellness & Culture: Freedom and responsibility culture, healthy snack allowances, team celebrations.
  • Continuous Learning: Programs to develop technical and soft skills.
  • Work Equipment: Equipment provided to create a productive workspace.
  • Tech & Office Allowances: One-time allowances to upgrade devices and home office setup.
  • Monthly Internet Allowance: Monthly allowance for internet and related expenses.
  • Compensation: Highly competitive package, in USD, with fixed and variable components.
  • Join us and grow in a flexible, innovative environment!
  • Additional note: Compensation will be in USD, commensurate with experience.

Before you apply, ensure your CV is in English; otherwise the application cannot be considered.

  • Stay current with design trends, emerging tools, and UX best practices to continuously elevate digital design standards.

Web Design Responsibilities

  • Design aesthetically refined, responsive websites and digital experiences that reflect brand identity and drive user engagement.
  • Craft visually dynamic layouts, landing pages, and UI components with a focus on clarity, hierarchy, and storytelling.

  • Design complementary digital assets such as banners, email templates, promotional graphics, and pop-ups that support campaign objectives.
  • Provide design QA during handoff and development phases to uphold visual quality and ensure design consistency.

Organizational & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Contribute to a creative and collaborative team environment by participating in critiques, brainstorming sessions, and cross-functional initiatives.
  • Manage multiple design projects with efficiency, consistently meeting deadlines while maintaining attention to visual and UX detail.
  • Maintain organized, well-labeled design files and ensure work is version-controlled and accessible across shared platforms.

What We’re Looking For

Education

  • 3 - 4-year Bachelor’s Degree or Diploma in Graphic Design, Interaction Design, or a related visual design discipline.

  • 3 - 5 years of experience in UX and visual design with a strong portfolio showcasing modern, clean, and user-focused work across web, mobile, and email.
  • Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign), Figma, and Mac-based design workflows.
  • Expertise in user experience design principles, user interface best practices, and visual storytelling across digital platforms.

  • Collaborative spirit, visual creativity, and a passion for delivering design that delights users and drives results.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. We require an HR function that thinks and acts globally. We're looking for a Lead HR Generalist to offer their expertise to our AMER region. It's an exciting time to join with the opportunity to help shape and create an HR function for the future. The senior role will serve as a driver and practitioner in both regional and global HR initiatives. You will join a global team of HR professionals to provide precise, compliant and scalable HR operations to the business, advise and execute on HR issues across the whole employee life-cycle, and partner with leadership in your region.   • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university

What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Se você é resiliente à pressão, ágil na edição, profissional, domina as ferramentas de edição e está pronto(a) para assumir demandas recorrentes com padrão elevado de entrega, essa oportunidade é para sua empresa!

Sobre a vaga

Buscamos um(a) editor(a) com experiência profissional na edição de vídeos curtos (formato Reels, Shorts, TikTok) com foco em cortes criativos e estilo viral.

O material bruto será enviado pela equipe estratégica e sua responsabilidade será realizar a edição completa, com cortes dinâmicos, inserção de legendas, memes e elementos visuais conforme o brand book das marcas. Bem como, elaborar a thumbnail com mockups existentes no Canva Pro.

Os vídeos são enviados toda segunda-feira, e a entrega final precisa ser feita ao longo da semana conforme agenda proposta. Fique atento que somos bastante rígidos ao cumprimento de SLAs.

Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência comprovada com edição de vídeos curtos e virais para redes sociais;
  • Portfólio profissional obrigatório (anexar no campo de currículo);
  • Domínio avançado em edições de vídeos profissionais, com usabilidade de Premiere Pro e After Effects;
  • Domínio avançado em edições de vídeos profissionais, com aplicação de motion design;
  • Domínio avançado em Canva Pro (edição de capa de vídeos, thumbnails, etc.);
  • Conhecimento avançado em Google Workspace;
  • Excelente senso estético, atenção a tendências visuais e replicação EXATA ao estilo da marca;
  • Capacidade de seguir referências com precisão e respeitar o brand book;
  • Equipamento próprio e softwares por conta do prestador (empresa não fornece);
  • Perfil ágil, comprometido e que cumpre prazos.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência PROFISSIONAL com edição para influenciadores, startups ou marcas com conteúdo digital estratégico;
  • Conhecimento em branding visual e adaptação de diferentes linguagens visuais;
  • Habilidade com legendas dinâmicas, memes e cortes no estilo “corte podcast”.

Modelo de contratação

  • Pessoa Jurídica (PJ);
  • Pagamento por hora trabalhada, com rastreamento automático via nosso sistema de controle interno;
  • A empresa remunera inclusive os minutos trabalhados, de forma transparente e justa;
  • Valor hora negociado entre as partes no momento da contratação;
  • Faturamento realizado até o quinto dia útil do mês subsequente;
  • Liberdade de horário : você define sua agenda, desde que cumpra os prazos de entrega;

Importante :

Essa é uma vaga para profissionais com know-how técnico.

Pedimos que não se candidatem pessoas sem experiência comprovada com motion design, vídeos curtos, cortes virais e linguagem visual para redes sociais. Por exemplo, ter apenas um conhecimento em CapCut não nos atende nesta vaga em específico. Precisamos de um editor profissional.

A qualidade da entrega será exigida desde o primeiro job, pois atuamos com padrão elevado nas três marcas do grupo.

Exemplos de entregas

Venha fazer parte de um time criativo, inovador e que acredita na excelência como diferencial!

Se você tem o perfil técnico, envie agora sua candidatura com portfólio anexo no campo de currículo.

Technical Author (multiple roles and seniority levels)

Join to apply for the Technical Author (multiple roles and seniority levels) role at Canonical

Our ambition is to set a standard of excellence in the industry for technical documentation and documentation practice. This is your chance to be a part of that, as a Technical Author at Canonical .
We are building documentation capacity at scale. We have dozens of positions available , for products and teams across the organisation, at all levels from Graduate to Senior Staff.
All applications and candidates are handled through this one entry-point. We'll be able to discuss seniority levels, suitable teams and more later in the process, to help place you in the most suitable role for you.
The role of a Technical Author
A Technical Author leads the documentation efforts of an engineering team, typically focused on a product or family of products. You'll help the team develop documentation that serves the needs of the product's users, embracing the principles of the Diátaxis documentation framework. You will have a broad impact on - and responsibility for - the quality of the user experience with the product, and will contribute towards the long-term success of the project itself.
These are not traditional technical writer roles. As a Technical Author, you will participate in development of product strategy. You will have input into product design and user experience. You will combine technical expertise with leadership in documentation, collaborating with colleagues across the company to establish documentation as a first-class engineering discipline. Even the most junior Technical Authors will have the opportunity to develop and demonstrate technical authority.
As well as your role in an engineering team, you will also be a part of Canonical's documentation practice team, that includes all the company's Technical Authors. Here, you'll be amongst other documentation experts, who collaborate to define documentation excellence and drive the development of documentation practice and theory, across the company and in the open-source software community.
Location: These are fully remote roles, open to candidates across the globe.
The role entails

  • Create, maintain and improve software documentation
  • Work with engineering team members, to help them make effective documentation contributions
  • Influence the development of the product, as an expert user of the product, who has important opinions about its function and design
  • Engage with user communities to ensure that our documentation meets their needs
  • Encourage and support community engagement in and contribution to documentation
  • Help standardise the structure, presentation, style and language of content across products
  • Collaborate with documentation peers to advance the state of the art in documentation at Canonical
  • Challenge and advance documentation understanding and best-practice, as part of a disciplinary team
What we are looking for in you
  • Cares deeply about functional written communication
  • Is a technical writer with a programmer's mindset, or a programmer with a record of producing excellent documentation
  • Has a record of community engagement, in open-source software, documentation, research or other disciplines
  • Is sympathetic to the needs and challenges of open-source software and its communities
  • Demonstrates technical curiosity, and is fascinated by software technology and its challenges
  • Has demonstrable documentation skills, insight and enthusiasm
  • Has experience of software development contexts; is familiar with: Linux, working on the command line, application deployment, system operations, and infrastructure management, Git, documentation markup languages
  • Has excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Holds a BSc/BA degree or equivalent
  • Is able to travel twice a year for up to two weeks for events
Nice-to-have skills
  • Deep technical domain knowledge
  • Open-source community leadership and management
  • User-experience, interaction or visual design
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Aqui, cada pessoa, seja cliente, líder ou colega, desempenha um papel essencial no nosso sucesso coletivo. Na Qive, estamos comprometidos em mudar a forma como o mercado se relaciona com Documentos Fiscais Eletrônicos (DFes), reduzindo horas operacionais, conomizando custos e mitigando riscos. Nossa cultura é orientada pela inovação, responsabilidade e agilidade, sempre com o objetivo de liderar o mercado e oferecer soluções que impulsionem o crescimento de nossos clientes.
