title: Direct Response Copywriter
description:
Overview

Job description

Pure is looking for a Direct Response Copywriter to join our team! As our creative head, you will be responsible for the ideation, scripting, planning, and managing of the entire creative process with a big focus on UGC ads and psychology-based creatives to be used across paid marketing channels.

We are looking to hire someone with 3+ years of work experience. The ideal candidate has prior experience in creating paid advertisements specifically for Meta Platforms, UGC, direct response marketing; bonus points if experience with influencer / UGC partnerships.

Who are we?

At Pure, we are dedicated to transforming lives by creating high-quality supplements backed by science and trusted by our growing community. Our mission is to make achieving better health simpler, more effective, and more accessible for everyone. Since our launch, we’ve scaled rapidly through viral digital marketing and built a passionate customer base that loves and trusts our products. We operate with a small but mighty team that thrives on innovation, data-driven growth, and relentless creativity—and we’re excited to bring on a Creative Strategist to play a pivotal role in scaling our brand even further.

What is our culture like & who is a good fit?

Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We utilize creativity to do more with less - and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by the following three core values: "work smart", "overdeliver", "speed is king" and "better everyday". We love learning - every problem is an opportunity to grow. If you want a stress-free corporate 9-5 job, this isn’t it.

If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast-growing company, work directly with the founders- and play a huge role in scaling it to $12M+ a year. Drive results with a group of passionate, smart & hardworking fun people. Work in an environment without politics, or corporate chicanery. Play a big part in our growth being hands on, active, and doing what is necessary with an excellent bonus plan based on performance then you have come to the right place.

Key Objectives

  • Manage the full creative process (from scripting all the way to final creative) in order to produce high converting creatives on an ongoing basis.
  • Work with our content manager to find, manage and source new content to be used across all marketing channels
  • Drive measurable improvements in core advertising metrics across digital channels with improved creatives.
  • Script UGC Direct response creatives
  • Use data from creative performance on Meta to dissect, analyze and improve upon our creatives to continuously improve performance across our creatives.
  • Work with our marketing team to come up with new creative concepts and ideas.
  • Conduct strategic customer and competitor research to better optimize creative efforts
  • Provide creative reports on a monthly and quarterly basis
  • Decide on the next steps needed to scale Meta Ads further through better creative

Requirements

  • Fully remote
  • Fluent in English
  • Direct Response Expertise: 3+ Years Experience with performance creative for DTC brands or working at a creative agency is a must.
  • Tools & Metrics: Proficiency in performance analytics tools such as Triple Whale, Motion, pitch decks, and spreadsheets to present ideas and campaign outcomes effectively.
  • UGC Experience: Lots of experience with creating briefs for UGC creators to produce high converting content across paid channels.
  • Creative & Analytical Mindset: Ability to generate fresh ideas, write scripts, shot listing, and make data-driven decisions based on ad performance.
  • No issue working overtime or on the weekends if needed. You wouldn’t know what to do with your free time if you were working less. You are passionate about your work.
  • Excellent cultural fit as per our values above.
  • Are excited to play a big role in scaling the company and work closely with the founders.
  • Basic psychology-based copywriting skills

Accountabilities

  • Brainstorm and pitch weekly ad ideas aligned with direct response principles.
  • Write 80-100 high-converting ad scripts per week for Meta Platforms
  • Come up with static ad ideas on a weekly basis
  • Analyze performance metrics to derive actionable insights for future campaigns.
  • Collaborate with editors and designers to ensure ads are visually compelling and on-brand.
  • Adapt ad strategies to capitalize on emerging internet trends and consumer behaviors.
  • Present performance analyses and creative strategies to the marketing team
  • Continuously refine ad concepts and troubleshoot underperforming campaigns to achieve maximum ROI.
  • Iterate on winning ads to create more winning assets to produce a better ROI.

How Our Hiring Works & How We Operate

When hiring, we’ll work with you to define the KPIs you’ll be responsible for and set targets. This removes ambiguity around wondering if you’re doing a good job after you start.

Initial soft interview, then a technical interview + test project with the current head of marketing, and a final interview to ensure culture fit. We plan to hire within ~8 - 10 days of conducting these interviews. We pride ourselves on timely responses and updates for applicants.

title: Coordenador de Sucesso do Cliente (Grandes Contas) Remoto
description:
Coordenador de Sucesso do Cliente (Grandes Contas)

O isaac é a maior plataforma de soluções financeiras feita para escolas. Impulsionamos as instituições oferecendo receita garantida e proporcionando mais flexibilidade de pagamento para as famílias.

Nosso objetivo é facilitar a gestão financeira, acabando com a dor de cabeça e permitindo que a escola consiga focar na missão de educar , dedicando mais tempo e recursos para tirar os planos do papel.

Nos últimos 4 anos, já ajudamos mais de 2.000 escolas, garantimos mais de R$5bi em mensalidades garantidas, e ajudamos a aumentar em 9% o número de matrículas em nossas escolas parceiras.

A cultura do isaac incentiva a autonomia, a mão na massa, o trabalho em equipe e o uso de dados para construir soluções inovadoras.

Temos muito para construir e transformar na Educação brasileira, e você pode fazer parte dessa revolução, vivenciando o impacto do seu trabalho na sociedade!

Vem com a gente?

Você será protagonista na gestão estratégica de escolas de grande porte que já utilizam o isaac. Seu papel vai muito além da manutenção da carteira: será responsável por impulsionar crescimento sustentável, maximizar o valor percebido e construir parcerias de longo prazo. Aqui, atuação consultiva é pré-requisito — você será a ponte entre as necessidades do cliente e as soluções que realmente fazem a diferença no dia a dia da escola.

Importante: Sabemos que o nosso produto tem um alto grau de complexidade e exige uma compreensão profunda do ecossistema financeiro educacional. Por isso, a atuação começa como contribuidora individual , com envolvimento direto nas contas para absorver as nuances do nosso negócio. Na sequência, você assume a frente da liderança do time , trazendo repertório, visão e consistência para nossa área de CS.

Responsabilidades:

  • Liderar a estratégia da frente de grandes contas, conectando visão de negócio, relacionamento consultivo e expansão de receita.

  • Gerenciar, inicialmente, uma carteira de escolas de grande porte com foco em retenção, crescimento (cross-sell e up-sell) e construção de parcerias duradouras.

  • Desenvolver relacionamentos estratégicos com mantenedores e tomadores de decisão, atuando como referência de confiança e geração de valor.

  • Diagnosticar cenários financeiros e operacionais para propor soluções alinhadas ao nosso portfólio.

  • Conduzir negociações complexas , envolvendo múltiplos stakeholders.

  • Acompanhar KPIs críticos, identificar riscos e oportunidades, e tomar decisões baseadas em dados.

  • Desenhar e evoluir processos da frente de grandes contas , com foco em eficiência, escalabilidade e encantamento.

  • Futuramente, estruturar e liderar um time, com responsabilidade pelo desenvolvimento, capacitação e performance da equipe.

Experiência sólida com Customer Success, KAM ou gestão de grandes contas , com resultados comprovados em retenção e expansão.

Histórico de liderança formal ou informal , com visão estratégica e capacidade de estruturação.

Habilidade em negociações de alto impacto , com múltiplos stakeholders.

Raciocínio lógico e analítico bem desenvolvido; domínio de indicadores financeiros e operacionais .

Perfil altamente consultivo, com foco em relacionamento e geração de valor.

Excelente comunicação e postura executiva.

Experiência com CRM (Salesforce, Zendesk ou similares) e ferramentas de BI.

Diferenciais que brilham os olhos:

  • Experiência anterior em empresas SaaS, fintechs ou de tecnologia B2B .

  • Atuação no setor educacional (escolas, mantenedoras, edtechs).

  • Vivência com indicadores financeiros e viabilidade de negócios .

  • Formação em Administração, Engenharia, Economia ou áreas correlatas .

#MaisDiversidade

Acreditamos que em um ambiente diverso e inclusivo nossas pessoas serão mais felizes, engajadas e com mais chances de atingir o seu máximo potencial . Por isso, aqui no isaac - uma empresa do Grupo Arco Educação, respeitamos e valorizamos a igualdade de direito, reconhecemos as singularidades e acreditamos que todas as pessoas podem contribuir para o nosso propósito. #vemproisaac

Declaração de Privacidade e Proteção de Dados

Quando você se candidata a uma das nossas vagas para ser isaacker, você nos fornece vários dados pessoais.

Ao final do processo seletivo, armazenamos o seu currículo em um banco de currículos, para o caso de surgirem novas vagas que tenham aderência ao seu perfil.

Para saber mais informações sobre como tratamos os seus dados e para exercer os seus direitos, acesse a nossa Declaração de Privacidade, disponível aqui .

title: Technology and Product Senior Software Engineer | CODE Brazil (Remote)
description:
Overview

Your wellbeing matters. Join a company that cares.

GET TO KNOW US

Wellhub (formerly Gympass*) is a corporate wellness platform that connects employees to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep, all included in one subscription designed to cost less than each individual partner. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in NYC, we have a growing global team in 11 countries. At Wellhub, you have the opportunity to build a career in a high-growth tech company that places wellbeing at the foundation of its culture, and contribute to making every company a wellness company.

*Big news: Gympass is now Wellhub! We are thrilled to announce our rebranding as Wellhub, marking a significant milestone in our journey. This transformation reflects our evolution from a “pass for gyms” to a comprehensive employee wellbeing solution. With our refreshed identity, we are poised to embark on an exciting new chapter of growth and expansion. We are elevating our offerings, including a completely new app experience and an expanded network of wellbeing partners. Learn more about it here.

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Senior Backend Software Engineer for our Booking team in Brazil!

CODE is an acronym for Consumer Digital Experience, which means we\'re in charge of the experience and services that will guide people\'s well-being journey. Our main goal in CODE is to make well-being universal. From knowing about Wellhub and getting access to exclusive benefits to using our vast partner network, it is all about the end-user experience.

The Check-in & Booking team enables users to use our partners’ services in a fast, easy, and frictionless way. We are responsible for developing and maintaining Wellhub\'s App, frontend, and backend services, and Design System, and work closely with product, UX, and data teams to create an excellent experience for the users of our platform.

Your Impact

Join our team as a Senior Software Engineer and shape our product\'s future. You\'ll architect, build, and deploy high-quality solutions, driving impactful improvements in a fast-paced agile setting. Lead technical discussions, mentor developers, and ensure code excellence through thorough reviews. Champion data-driven decisions, prioritize simplicity, and bring innovative ideas to life. Elevate your technical expertise and communication skills while contributing to our company\'s success.

  • Driven to deliver timely, high-quality work. Perform insightful pull-request reviews and build reusable code
  • Be data-driven and participate in and/or lead architectural decisions, share improvement opportunities, bring innovation to the table, and make sure design docs are up to date
  • Promote the long-term technical health of our journeys
  • Take part in incident resolution and troubleshooting in the production environment
  • Take ownership of critical features, be accountable, and possess a high level of ownership by following up on engineering SLOs and product KPIs
  • Interact with the product team and stakeholders to impact the business
  • Mentoring other engineers
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life balance.

Who You Are

  • A true team player who loves working towards both team and individual goals with at least 5 years of experience in web development.
  • An engineer with a bachelor’s degree in computer science or equivalent professional experience
  • Experience in designing and developing modern web applications
  • Proficient in one or more programming languages (Java / Kotlin / Scala). Scala will be considered a plus
  • Experience with SQL and NoSQL technologies such as PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, Redis, understanding common use cases, and performance pitfalls
  • Experience dealing with event-driven architectures and message brokers such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, SNS, etc., and an in-depth understanding of their use cases and pitfalls
  • Experience with microservices and high-volume distributed systems
  • Experience with Cloud-based architectures in AWS
  • Strong communication skills, including verbal and written English and Portuguese

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don\'t match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience in backend programming languages and AWS are mandatory requirements.

What We Offer You

We\'re a wellness company that is committed to the health and wellbeing of our employees. Our flexible program allows you to customize your benefits, according to your needs!

Our benefits include:

WELLHUB: We believe in our mission and encourage our employees and their families to take care of their wellbeing too. Access onsite gyms and fitness studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental health support, and more. You will receive the Gold plan at no cost, and other premium plans will be significantly discounted.

WELLNESS: Health, dental, and life insurance.

FLEXIBLE WORK: At Wellhub, flexibility fosters a happier, healthier, and more productive work environment for everyone. As a Flexible First company, we offer two work model options: flexible hybrid and full remote, and make the office a place for collaboration, community, and team building. The model for this role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. We offer all employees a home office stipend and a monthly flexible work allowance to help cover the costs of working from home.

Tridge Eye is our proprietary intelligence platform that transforms complex global trade data into actionable insights.   • Negotiation & Contract Execution : Lead commercial negotiations, secure agreements with optimal terms, and ensure smooth contract execution in collaboration with internal teams.
  • Segment & Vertical-Specific Market Strategies: Develop differentiated go-to-market strategies tailored to each vertical and customer segment, considering unique industry trends, customer behaviors, and competitive landscapes to maximize penetration and conversion.

What You Bring

  • Proven Sales Experience: 3+ years in B2B tech, platform, or data/intelligence sales, with a strong track record in managing the full sales cycle — from lead generation (both outbound and inbound) to closing — particularly with Enterprise-level deals.
  • Market Segmentation & Strategy Skills: Demonstrated ability to develop and execute differentiated go-to-market strategies by vertical and customer segment, leveraging market intelligence to maximize penetration and conversion.
  • Customer-Centric Proposal Development: Ability to selectively utilize pre-sales assets, GTM materials, and marketing content tailored to industry-specific needs, enhancing the quality and impact of proposals.
  • Understanding of Customer Structure and Pain Points: Understand the decision-making structure of customer organizations and deliver optimized solution value based on this insight.
  • Must be located in Sao Paulo

Great to Haves

  • Understanding of supply chain structures and industry-specific pain points, especially within agri/food or related sectors.
  • Familiarity with data-driven sales, including analyzing market or supply chain data to strengthen proposals.
  • Background in both Business Development Representative (BDR) and Account Executive (AE) roles, handling outbound prospecting and closing.

As we continue to grow and transform we ensure that our values are at the top of everyone’s minds

  • Care : We genuinely care about our customers, people, products, and society.
  • Discipline : We value the discipline to set ambitious goals and overcome obstacles through perseverance.
  • Intensity : We maintain a high level of focus and commitment to achieve our goals in a competitive environment.

Why Join Us

  • Tridge offers you a Remote Working model that provides flexibility and balance in how you manage your work life and personal life.
  • We will provide you with training on our solutions and access to all the up-to-date software tools you’ll need to succeed.
  • Career Path that recognises excellence and supports growth: You can be eligible for career progression over the course of your contract term. You will have the ability to grow within a rapidly expanding global company.
  • You will have clearly defined objectives and clear ways to measure your impact.
  • You will be paid a competitive base salary along with solid earning potential through our incentive program.
  • Be part of revolutionising the trading and agriculture industry by improving global supply chain efficiency–through digitization, intelligence, and our vast global network.

Overview

National Consultant for the development of Risk Communication toolkit and course, Brasilia (home-based), Brazil, (6 months).

Join to apply for the National Consultant role at UNICEF. In conflict and disaster, children suffer first and suffer most. UNICEF works to strengthen the links between humanitarian action and development work, delivering a continuum of support. In Brazil, UNICEF supports child-centred disaster risk reduction interventions and emergency responses, such as the Venezuelan migration outflow and the drought in the Amazon Region. In the last two years, UNICEF contributed to the Yanomami public health emergency and the response to the floods in Rio Grande do Sul. UNICEF’s crosscutting focus includes Social and Behaviour Change (SBC), and Risk Communication and Community Engagement (RCCE) is a key component of preparedness and response.

Under the guidance of the Social and Behaviour Change Officer, in coordination with the Emergency Specialist and the RCCE Specialist, the consultant will support UNICEF in producing a Toolkit and course on Risk Communication and Community Engagement in Brazil, liaising with all field offices that respond to humanitarian situations in the country. The consultancy covers a 6-month period and aims to develop an RCCE Toolkit and a short RCCE course for public managers involved in emergency preparedness and response in Brazil.

Work assignments and deliverables

  • RCCE Toolkit: Mapping — Map UNICEF's existing materials/tools since 2018 (migration response, COVID-19, and recent emergencies) and organize the materials in an online repository. Deliverables include a cloud-based, catalogued repository and a document listing mapped materials. Timeline: after 30 days of contract signature. Budget: 10% of consultancy fee.
  • RCCE Toolkit: Message Matrix — Develop a comprehensive matrix with child-centered key messages by emergency type (drought, smoke/fires, floods) for each of the five UNICEF Goal Areas (Health and Nutrition, WASH, Education, Child Protection, Social Policy). Messages will be used for advocacy and field contexts; the template will be developed in coordination with UNICEF. Deliverables: a spreadsheet with priority messages per type of emergency and area. Timeline: after 60 days. Budget: 20% of consultancy fee.
  • Child-centred RCCE Course — Develop an 8-hour training course (with 4-hour and 2-hour options) in Portuguese, including at least one practical co-construction exercise. Provide an online version adapted for the EV.G platform, with two short tutorial videos. The consultant is not responsible for platform programming but will provide scripts. Deliverables include facilitator’s guide, participant workbook, planning checklist, presentation, and online course script with quizzes and media guidelines. Timeline: after 90 days. Budget: 20% of consultancy fee.
  • RCCE Toolkit: Testing — Conduct pretesting of key messages and draft materials with affected populations and local partners, with no travel required (UNICEF will implement in selected locations). Deliverables: short report on testing, methodologies, and adaptations. Timeline: after 120 days. Budget: 15% of consultancy fee.
  • RCCE Toolkit: Materials — Produce final materials for the toolkit (25 posters, 25 card series, 25 flyers, 25 radio scripts) with a user guide and a cloud repository for high-quality PDFs, PNGs, and .doc files. Timeline: after 150 days. Budget: 35% of consultancy fee.

Travel plan

No travel planned for this consultancy.

Minimum qualifications

  • A university degree in social and behavioural sciences, social communication, sociology, anthropology, psychology, education, public relations, or related field.
  • At least 4 years of professional experience in RCCE, CwC, SBC, C4D or related areas; experience in humanitarian settings and producing content for affected populations; portfolio required.
  • Knowledge of children’s rights issues (CRC and the Statute of the Child and Adolescent is an asset).
  • Ability to manage relationships with partners, including government counterparts and communities; strong writing and communication skills in Portuguese.
  • Experience in a UN system agency or humanitarian/development organization is an asset.

Language proficiency

  • Fluency in Portuguese is required. English is an asset.

Financial proposal

  • Financial proposal must include all-inclusive fees (lump sum, travel costs, subsistence) based on deliverables and days requested.

Remarks

UNICEF’s Core Values of Care, Respect, Integrity, Trust and Accountability and Sustainability guide all work. UNICEF provides inclusive accommodation where possible. UNICEF has a zero-tolerance policy on exploitation, abuse, discrimination, and safeguarding; background checks may be required. Consultants are responsible for visa and health insurance and for tax obligations according to local laws. SARS-CoV-2 vaccination status may be required for on-site assignments.

With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world\'s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine. By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we\'re helping usher in the promise of AI. Job Title: Generative AI Associate Analyst (LLM Training – Medical Domain)

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Flexible Contract Role (Part-time, up to 25 hours weekly)

About The Role

We are seeking highly qualified professionals with (Master\'s or PhD) in Medical Microbiology to support the development of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs). As a Rater / AI Trainer, you will play a critical role in shaping how AI understands and communicates complex biomedical knowledge, with a specific focus on microbiological sciences. This role involves evaluating AI-generated responses for scientific accuracy, contextual integrity, and clinical relevance within the field of medical microbiology. Your feedback and annotations will inform the improvement of AI systems used in healthcare education, diagnostics support, public health communication, and biomedical research.

  • Critically assess AI-generated responses in topics including microbial taxonomy, infectious disease mechanisms, host–pathogen interactions, diagnostic microbiology, antimicrobial resistance, and laboratory methodologies.
  • Apply structured annotation to texts, including labelling for scientific correctness, terminology accuracy, logical structure, and clinical relevance.
  • Categorize model outputs using domain-specific taxonomies (e.g., pathogen type, disease process, diagnostic method).
  • Create real-world clinical or laboratory scenarios with researchers to design and test prompts to assess the model\'s reasoning and adaptability to professional contexts (e.g., interpreting culture reports, recommending diagnostic tests, understanding resistance profiles).

Required Qualifications

  • Master\'s or PhD in Medical Microbiology, Immunology, or a closely related biomedical discipline.
  • Demonstrated expertise in core areas such as microbial pathogenesis, clinical diagnostics, virology, bacteriology, parasitology, and immunology.
  • Familiarity with laboratory procedures, microbiological instrumentation, and interpretation of diagnostic test results (e.g., blood cultures, PCR, AST).
  • Excellent written communication skills and fluency in English.

Também é legal você saber que...
Um dos nossos 7 valores é o “Sawabona", seu significado é pra lá de especial, e praticado diariamente aqui na Zappts!
A saudação #Sawabona se originou no Sul da África, onde se acredita que todos nascemos pessoas boas, mas que, às vezes, podemos cometer alguns erros.
Segundo a cultura deste lugar, quando alguém comete erros, toda a população se junta e, durante dois dias, só falam sobre as coisas boas que aquela pessoa já fez. Ao final desse período, todo o povo cumprimenta seu conterrâneo com a expressão "Sawabona".
Esse, por sua vez, responde "#Shikoba" . Sendo assim, Sawabona significa: "Eu te vejo, eu te respeito, você é importante para mim" . E a resposta, Shikoba: "Então eu sou bom e existo para você" .
Aqui na Zappts, Sawabona traduz e representa o que mais prezamos em nossas relações: o respeito e a valorização do outro.
Se você é apaixonado por tecnologia e sentiu conexão com os nossos valores, venha para nossa tribo aqui é seu lugar!

Who we are

Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company with 61,000+ employees, approximately 1000 laboratories across 61 countries, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic, and labelling is accurate.

Eurofins is dedicated to delivering testing services that contribute to the health and safety of society and the planet, and to its corporate responsibility to protect the environment and ensure diversity, equity, and inclusion across the entire network of Eurofins companies.

The Team

Eurofins endeavours to develop all of our software applications in-house to service and support our numerous laboratories globally. With hundreds of thousands of clinical diagnostic tests performed every day, the laboratories of the Eurofins clinical diagnostic services business line strive to ensure that every patient, wherever he or she lives, has access to the most specialized and most innovative techniques for diagnosis, monitoring and therapeutic decisions. Such activities require extensive planning and organisation which can be augmented by the use of technology.

Our Clinical LIMS Europe Program will extensively be used as the central Laboratory Information Management System throughout Europe, this role is crucial in defining and delivering the product roadmap.

Job Focus

In the role, you will work with a dedicated, enthusiastic team developing enhancements to a Laboratory Information Management System (a LIMS) and supporting the LIMS' multiple customers. This position supports Brazil-based operations and the Europe LIMS program as described above.

Responsibilities

  • Estimate the complexity and the workload
  • Choose the most appropriate technical solution to meet the user requirements
  • Design, develop and deploy changes to the LIMS according to the customers’ and business users’ requirements
  • Support the LIMS in collaboration with other team members
  • Work together with other team members (Engineers/QA) to ensure high quality of delivered solutions
  • Ensure good practices and high quality standards are implemented and followed

Experience / Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience developing solutions using Embarcadero Delphi 2006 or later (Delphi 12 preferable)
  • Experience with using Delphi to develop Windows Services and/or UI Forms is a bonus
  • 2+ years of experience with Oracle PL/SQL
  • Strong working knowledge on server-side development with Delphi and/or with Oracle PL/SQL
  • Strong analytical, problem solving and troubleshooting skills
  • Good understanding of relational databases (Oracle 9i, 11c or later)
  • Strong knowledge of Agile software development practices, particularly Scrum and/or Kanban
  • Clear experience in collaboration with Business Analysts and Software Architect(s)
  • Some experience in test driven development and test automation
  • Comfortable in unit testing and mocking with Delphi
  • Ability to translate functional requirements into technical solutions

Education

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or similar

What else should I know?

As the role and Eurofins' IT Talent Acquisition team are international, please ensure to submit your application in English.

description:
Overview

We are a tech-enabled growth firm–at the intersection of marketing, consulting & data intelligence–igniting revenue and brand recognition for leading and emerging companies around the world. As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. As a full-service growth marketing firm, we offer best-in-class services including: SEO, Content Marketing, Paid Media, Social Media Marketing, Programmatic + CTV, Public Relations, Influencer Marketing, Email + SMS, Conversion Rate Optimization, Retail Marketing, and Creative. Here at Power Digital, we are hyper-focused on helping brands drive revenue growth and brand recognition, ultimately driving irrefutable value for our clients.

At the heart of Power Digital is our proprietary technology, nova, which analyzes businesses through first-party data, simplifying investment planning for marketing and diligence in M&A––putting marketers in a strategic seat at the table––and providing value in unparalleled ways. Managing billions in media, our dynamic team––of consultative marketers, creatives, analysts and technologists––challenge traditional ways of planning and measurement through meticulous testing and data science across each milestone of the customer journey.

Proficiency in spoken and written English at an advanced level is required for this role.

A day in the life:

  • The ideal candidate will possess a strong understanding of data analysis, reporting, and visualization, as well as the ability to effectively communicate insights to clients. In this role, you will be responsible for creating and maintaining reports that directly impact client business performance, conducting deep dive analyses, and translating complex data into actionable insights. You will work directly with marketing tools and platforms to access campaign data, build compelling presentations, and identify optimization opportunities across multiple channels.

Responsibilities:

  • Build and maintain automated reports for eComm, B2B, and B2C with performance metrics across all marketing channels based on client needs and our recommendations
  • Access and analyze data directly from marketing platforms (Meta Business Manager, Google Ads, Google Analytics, etc.) to identify meaningful performance insights
  • Create and update weekly, monthly, and quarterly performance decks with a focus on data storytelling and actionable recommendations
  • Conduct deep dive analyses to uncover optimization opportunities and answer specific business questions
  • Transform complex data into clear, concise visualizations that effectively communicate performance to clients and internal stakeholders
  • Utilize Google Sheets and other tools for sophisticated data manipulation and analysis
  • Simplify and present findings eloquently with a focus on connecting data to business outcomes
  • Employ AI technologies to enhance reporting capabilities and generate deeper insights
  • Utilize and leverage Power Digital's Nova ecosystem to enhance reporting capabilities

Role Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Analytics, or a related field
  • 2+ years of experience in marketing analytics or digital marketing
  • Strong understanding of digital marketing metrics, campaign structures, and customer journey
  • Familiarity with major digital marketing platforms (Meta, Google Ads, Google Analytics, etc.)
  • Advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills for data manipulation and analysis (pivot tables, VLOOKUP, etc.)
  • Experience with data visualization tools such as Looker, Tableau, PowerBI, or Google Data Studio
  • Understanding of statistical concepts like regression modeling, test/control analysis, etc.
  • Experience creating performance presentations and conveying data narratives
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team
  • Strong attention to detail and analytical thinking
  • Self-motivated and able to work under pressure and meet deadlines

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Task Delivery Rate: 90%+ Tasks completed on or before delivery date
  • Task Accuracy Rate: 90%+ Tasks completed successfully on initial delivery (tasks not re-opened for inaccuracies or missed requirements)

Most Important Things (MITs)

  • Data Storytelling and Insight Generation: Transform raw data into meaningful narratives that highlight key performance indicators, trends, and actionable recommendations. Connect marketing metrics to business outcomes in a way that resonates with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Marketing Channel Expertise: Maintain deep understanding of digital marketing platforms, metrics, and campaign structures. Stay current with platform changes and be able to contextualize performance data within the broader marketing strategy.
  • Client Communication and Reporting Excellence: Develop clear, visually appealing reports and presentations that effectively communicate performance insights. Proactively identify opportunities, address client questions, and maintain regular communication regarding deliverables and timelines.
  • Continuous Improvement of Reporting Systems: Constantly seek ways to enhance reporting templates, dashboards, and analysis methodologies. Streamline reporting processes, improve visualization techniques, and incorporate new metrics to provide more comprehensive performance insights.

Power Digital’s people and culture are at the core of our success, which is why diversity in our team’s backgrounds and experiences are paramount. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds, who strive to make an impact inside and outside of the workplace. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employees' points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

Bonsai is an all-in-one platform helping agencies, consultancies, and professional service firms run and scale their operations. From lean 5-person studios to 100-person teams, thousands of businesses around the world rely on Bonsai to streamline their workflows and manage everything from proposals and contracts to tasks, time tracking, invoicing, and finances.

We’re profitable, growing fast, and backed by world-class investors including Y Combinator, Matrix Partners, and Index Ventures.

About the Role

We’re looking for a detail-oriented Data Onboarding Specialist to join our team and play a key role in helping new customers set up and migrate their data into Bonsai. This role is less about advanced analytics and coding, and more about ensuring customer data is clean, structured, and seamlessly integrated (primarily using Excel and Google Sheets).

You’ll work directly with customer success, operations, and product teams to make onboarding as smooth and efficient as possible. If you love working with spreadsheets, have an eye for detail, and enjoy finding creative ways to manipulate data, this role is for you.

What You’ll Do

  • Manage and support customer data migrations during onboarding

This role blends content strategy, project management, copywriting, and digital performance analysis - perfect for someone who thrives on moving seamlessly between planning and execution. You’ll be the glue connecting design, video, and messaging, turning ideas into structured campaigns that perform across IG, X, LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok, and email.
In this role, you’ll build a structured, scalable marketing engine that expands reach and drives inbound interest, creating high-impact content that lives across social, email, and the web. You’ll develop reporting frameworks that give the creative team the insights to continuously improve, and you’ll help define a consistent, modern voice for one of the fastest-growing agencies in the world.
This is a fully remote role operating in the EST time zone, open to candidates in Portugal and Brazil.
What You’ll Do
Strategy, Planning & Execution

  • Own the content calendar: Plan, manage, and execute the content pipeline across IG, X, LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok and email using Notion.
  • Coordinate across teams: Work closely with the Design Lead and Video Lead to align on timelines, asset creation, and creative strategy.
  • Deploy consistently: Schedule and publish all organic social posts and newsletters. Ensure content is on-message and on time.
  • Stay agile: Adapt to shifting priorities and post needs without dropping quality or speed.
  • Coordinate the email pipeline: Plan email newsletters.
  • Drive Darkroom’s email strategy: Support strategic initiatives for Darkroom’s email marketing campaigns in partnership with the Design Lead and Video Lead
Social Media Management
  • Hands-on ownership of Darkroom’s organic presence on Instagram, LinkedIn, X, and YouTube.
  • Write copy: Post captions, headlines and descriptions that match platform-specific tone and brand voice.
  • Community engagement: Monitor and respond to comments and DMs. Actively engage with customers, creators, and collaborators.
Paid Media
  • Have an understanding of paid social and ad copywriting
  • You will work and PM our paid media specialist on Darkroom’s paid ads
SEO, Reporting, Analytics & Performance
  • Work with our SEO specialist to track everything: Monitor performance across all owned platforms and campaigns (social, email, website).
  • SEO + UX insights: Use Microsoft Clarity and Google Analytics to identify friction points and opportunities for optimization.
  • Report intelligently: Provide actionable insights, trends, and growth metrics that influence creative direction.
You’re a Great Fit If You:
  • Have 5+ years of experience in digital marketing, with a strong focus on content, email, and social.
  • Are highly organized, autonomous, and thrive in fast-paced, iterative environments.
  • Write with precision and tone, and know how to adapt voice across channels.
  • Know what content performs, and why.
  • Have strong project management instincts and can juggle timelines, tasks and tools.
  • Understand digital performance: you’ve worked with analytics tools, know your way around email metrics and think SEO.
  • Communicate clearly and can collaborate with designers and video editors.
Bonus Points If You:
  • Have experience working inside an agency.
  • Have managed newsletter content and owned media channels
  • Are fluent in Notion, Figma, Google Analytics, Microsoft Clarity, GT Metrix
  • Have worked on brand-led social content

We're building the future of advertising and are looking for the minds to help us do it. We only seek out the best—from our clients to our people. Our team is our most sacred asset, and we offer highly competitive salaries and the following perks:
  • Unlimited Vacation Policy and Holidays: Rebooting is one of the most important parts of growth. At Darkroom, you have access to a flexible vacation policy and 10 holidays throughout the year to keep you recharged and sharp.
  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote-first culture with a strong community base. With Hubs in the Bay Area, New York, Philly, Lisbon, Sao Paulo, and Barcelona!
  • Finances, growth, and retirement: Equity incentives, and a profit-sharing opportunity so we can help you save as the company grows.

Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross-functional collaboration.
  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work-life balance.
